variations: Short: life won't stay in the valley forever, but the first thing to learn there isn't how to climb out — it's how to sit down
Advanced: 'bounce back' is everyone else's expectation of you. It's not your duty to yourself.

items.sourceNote: 台劇《犀利人妻》「可是瑞凡，我們回不去了」經典台詞延伸，原創成年人關係回不去觀察

zh-tw.content:
《犀利人妻》那句已經被講爛的：

「可是瑞凡，
我們回不去了。」

二十歲看，覺得是分手台詞。
三十歲看，才發現——

它說的不只是愛情。

你跟最好的朋友冷戰半年，
後來想找他出來吃飯，
打字到一半，
你發現——

回不去了。

你離開那家公司之後，
同事傳訊息說「找一天聚一下」，
你笑著回「好啊」，
心裡知道——

回不去了。

你跟爸媽吵了那一架，
他們後來假裝沒發生，
你也假裝沒發生，
但每一通電話之間的空氣——

回不去了。

長大的痛點不叫「失去」。

叫「明明都還在，但已經不一樣了」。

他還在你的通訊錄，
但你不會打給他。

她還在你的限動觀眾名單，
但你們不會再見面。

那家店還開著，
但你不會再進去點那一杯。

回不去，
不代表不愛。

只是——

大家都長大了，
而長大這件事，
沒有回頭路。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個還在想「為什麼我們再也回不到從前」的朋友——回不去不代表不愛，只是大家都長大了，而長大沒有回頭路
variations: 短版：可是瑞凡，我們回不去了
進階版：長大的痛點不是失去，是明明都還在，但已經不一樣了

en.content:
That line from The Fierce Wife,
quoted to death in Taiwan:

"But Rui-fan,
we can't go back."

At twenty, you hear it as a breakup line.
At thirty, you realize —

it's not just about love.

You and your best friend went six months without speaking.
You start typing to suggest dinner,
and halfway through, you realize —

you can't go back.

After you left that job,
a coworker texts "let's grab a meal sometime,"
you reply "sure!" with a smile,
knowing —

you can't go back.

You had that one fight with your parents.
They pretend it didn't happen.
You pretend it didn't happen.
But the air between every phone call after —

can't go back.

The ache of growing up isn't "losing."

It's "everything is still here, but it's not the same anymore."

He's still in your contacts,
but you won't call.

She's still on your close friends list,
but you won't meet again.

That café is still open,
but you won't go in and order that drink.

"Can't go back"
doesn't mean "didn't love."

It just means —

everyone grew up,
and growing up
has no return ticket.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend still wondering 'why can't we ever go back to how we were' — can't go back doesn't mean didn't love. Everyone just grew up, and growing up has no return ticket.
variations: Short: but Rui-fan, we can't go back.
Advanced: the ache of growing up isn't losing. It's 'everything is still here, but it's not the same anymore.'

items.sourceNote: 2026台劇《動物園》職涯轉彎主題延伸，原創中年轉職的勇氣觀察

zh-tw.content:
《動物園》邵雨薇那場戲——
從廣告公司創意總監，
變成動物園的實習保育員。

她蹲在猩猩面前，
說了一句台詞：

「我以前以為自己很厲害，
是因為我能掌控一切。

現在我才知道——

真正的厲害，
是承認自己什麼都不會，
然後從零開始學。」

三十五歲轉職，
最難的關卡不在技術。

在面子。

是你以前在會議室裡指點江山，
現在要跟二十二歲的同事說「請教一下」。

是你以前的職稱是「總監」，
現在的職稱是「實習」。

是你以前年薪兩百萬，
現在月薪三萬五。

但你會發現——

當你願意把「總監」這個包袱放下，
你才終於變回那個——

二十二歲、什麼都敢試、什麼都不怕的自己。

年紀大不可怕。

可怕的是——

用「我這個年紀」這四個字，
把自己關起來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直想轉換跑道、但被「我這個年紀」綁住的朋友——把總監這個包袱放下，你才會變回什麼都敢試的自己
variations: 短版：真正的厲害，是承認自己什麼都不會，然後從零開始學
進階版：年紀大不可怕，可怕的是用「我這個年紀」把自己關起來

en.content:
There's a scene in Zoo —
Shao Yu-wei goes from creative director at an ad agency
to an intern keeper at the zoo.

She crouches in front of a gorilla
and delivers this line:

"I used to think I was impressive
because I could control everything.

Now I know —

real strength
is admitting you know nothing
and starting over from zero."

Switching careers at thirty-five.
The hardest part isn't the skills.

It's the ego.

It's that you used to run the room in meetings,
and now you're asking a twenty-two-year-old coworker "could you show me?"

Your old title was "Director."
Your new title is "Intern."

You used to make two hundred grand.
Now you make thirty-five hundred a month.

But here's what you find —

the moment you put down the weight of "Director,"
you finally become —

that twenty-two-year-old again. The one who tried everything. Was afraid of nothing.

Getting older isn't the scary part.

The scary part is —

using the words "at my age"
to lock yourself in a box.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend who keeps wanting to switch careers but stays trapped by 'at my age' — put down the Director title and you'll find the version of you who was afraid of nothing
variations: Short: real strength is admitting you know nothing and starting over from zero
Advanced: getting older isn't scary. The scary part is using 'at my age' to lock yourself in a box

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇《依然閃亮》跨越十年初戀主題延伸，原創成年人重逢觀察

zh-tw.content:
《依然閃亮》朴珍榮跟金玟周
隔了十年再見面，
第一句話不是「你過得好嗎」，
是——

「你還是
喜歡靠窗的位置嗎？」

看到這裡，
我把手機放下，
深呼吸了一下。

因為這就是初戀最殘忍的地方——

你以為你忘了，
但你記得他不吃香菜。
你記得他過敏會打三個噴嚏，不是兩個。
你記得他笑的時候，
左邊酒窩比右邊深一點。

這些細節，
你沒有刻意記，
但它們一直都在那裡。

十年後重逢，
最尷尬的不是不熟悉，
是——

你太熟悉了。

熟悉到你怕一開口，
就洩漏這十年來，
你其實偷偷地，
還在用他的偏好過生活。

你之所以坐靠窗，
不是因為你喜歡。

是因為你習慣了，
身邊坐的是他。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個假裝自己早就忘了初戀、但每次點咖啡都還是「他喜歡的那種」的朋友——你以為你忘了，但身體記得
variations: 短版：你還是喜歡靠窗的位置嗎？
進階版：你之所以坐靠窗，不是因為你喜歡，是因為你習慣了身邊坐的是他

en.content:
In Still Bright,
Park Jin-young and Kim Min-ju
meet again after ten years apart.
His first line isn't "how have you been."

It's —
"Do you still

like the seat by the window?"
I put down my phone
and took a long breath.

Because this is what's brutal about first love —

you think you've forgotten,
but you remember he doesn't eat cilantro.
You remember his allergies make him sneeze three times, not two.
You remember when he smiles,
the left dimple is slightly deeper than the right.

You never tried to memorize these things.
They just stayed.
Reuniting ten years later,

the awkward part isn't being strangers.
It's —
being too familiar.

Familiar enough that you're scared the moment you speak,

you'll give away the secret —
that for ten years,
you've quietly
been living by his preferences.

The reason you sit by the window
isn't because you like it.

It's because you got used to
him sitting next to you.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who pretends they're long over their first love but still orders 'the kind he liked' every time — you think you forgot, but the body remembers
variations: Short: do you still like the seat by the window?
Advanced: the reason you sit by the window isn't because you like it. It's because you got used to him sitting next to you.

items.sourceNote: 2026《莎拉的真偽人生》「人們相信的就是真相」主題延伸，原創信念與事實的觀察

zh-tw.content:
《莎拉的真偽人生》申惠善那句——

「人們往往認為，
自己相信的，
就是真相。」

短短一句，
但我想了很久。

因為我發現——

我們吵架，
從來與「對錯」無關。

為的是——

「我相信的，比你相信的更接近真相。」

你媽說「我都是為你好」，
她真的相信。
你前任說「我從來沒有騙過你」，
他也真的相信。
你的同事說「我那天沒有講你壞話」，
他發誓他真的相信。

問題不是他們在說謊。

問題是——

人類有一種天賦，
叫做「把自己想做的事，
包裝成自己該做的事」。

然後——

再相信它一輩子。

所以下次有人說「我是真心的」，
你不用急著反駁。

他真的是。

只是「真心」這兩個字，
從來都沒有保證過——

他是對的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直被別人「真心話」綁架的朋友——真心不等於正確，他相信不代表那就是真相
variations: 短版：人們往往認為，自己相信的，就是真相
進階版：「真心」這兩個字，從來都沒有保證過他是對的

en.content:
Shin Hye-sun's line in The Art of Sarah —

"People tend to believe
that what they believe
is the truth."

One short line.
I sat with it for a long time.

Because I realized —

we never argue
about right and wrong.

We argue about —

"what I believe is closer to the truth than what you believe."

Your mom says "I'm doing this for your own good."
She genuinely believes it.
Your ex says "I never lied to you."
He genuinely believes it.
Your coworker swears "I didn't talk about you that day."
He genuinely believes it.

The problem isn't that they're lying.

The problem is —

humans have this gift
for wrapping "what I want to do"
in the package of "what I should do."

And then —

believing it for the rest of their lives.

So next time someone says "I mean it sincerely,"
you don't have to fight them.

They do mean it.

It's just that the word "sincere"
has never once guaranteed —

that they're right.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps getting steamrolled by other people's 'sincere intentions' — sincerity isn't accuracy. They believe it. That doesn't make it true.
variations: Short: people tend to believe that what they believe is the truth
Advanced: the word 'sincere' has never once guaranteed that they're right

items.sourceNote: 2026《淚之女王》愛情與承諾主題延伸，原創成年人的告白觀察

zh-tw.content:
《淚之女王》金秀賢對金智媛說的：

「我不會說
『我一輩子都會愛你』
這種話。

我只會說——

今天，
我選擇你。

明天醒來，
我會再選一次。」

小時候看偶像劇，
最喜歡聽「我會愛你一輩子」。

長大以後，
你才知道——

「一輩子」太輕了。

輕到任何人喝醉、心動、寂寞，
都能在三秒鐘內說出口。

真正重的，
是「每天」。

是你今天累得要死，
還是選擇打那通電話。
是你今天明明很煩，
還是選擇聽他講完那件無聊的小事。
是你今天明明可以離開，
還是選擇留下來。

愛情從來不是一張承諾書。

是——

每天早上醒來，
你都還想再選他一次。

選不下去的那天，
才是真正的結束。

不是吵架，不是出軌，
是——

「今天我不想選了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個還在等對方說「一輩子」的朋友——一輩子太便宜，「每天都還想選你一次」才是真的
variations: 短版：我不會說一輩子都愛你，我只會說——今天，我選擇你
進階版：愛情從來不是承諾書，是每天早上醒來，你都還想再選他一次

en.content:
What Kim Soo-hyun says to Kim Ji-won in Queen of Tears:

"I won't say
'I'll love you forever.'

I'll only say —

Today,
I choose you.

Tomorrow when I wake up,
I'll choose you again."

When we were young watching dramas,
the favorite line was always "I'll love you forever."

Then you grew up
and realized —

"forever" is light.

Light enough that anyone — drunk, infatuated, lonely —
can say it in three seconds.

The thing that's actually heavy
is "today."

Today you're exhausted,
and you still chose to make the call.
Today you're in a terrible mood,
and you still chose to listen to his boring little story.
Today you could leave,
and you still chose to stay.

Love was never a contract.

It's —

waking up every morning
and still wanting to choose him again.

The day you can't choose anymore
is the real ending.

Not the fight. Not the affair.
Just —

"Today, I don't want to choose."
en.editorNote: Send to the friend still waiting for someone to say 'forever' — forever is cheap. 'I want to choose you again today' is the real one.
variations: Short: I won't say I'll love you forever. I'll only say — today, I choose you
Advanced: love was never a contract. It's waking up every morning and still wanting to choose him again

items.sourceNote: 2026《低谷醫生》朴信惠朴炯植躺平休息哲學延伸，原創成年人疲憊觀察

zh-tw.content:
《低谷醫生》最被截圖的那句：

「既然都倒下了，
就躺著吧。

不一定要立刻爬起來，
不一定要馬上想通，

地板很涼，
躺一下沒關係。」

看到這句的當下，
我整個人愣了三秒。

因為從小到大，
沒有人這樣對我說過。

他們都說——

「跌倒了就要趕快站起來。」
「你要更努力。」
「別人都做得到，為什麼你不行？」

好像「倒下」是一種羞恥，
「休息」是一種逃避，
「不想再撐」是一種失敗。

可是長大之後你才明白——

有些倒下，
跟強不強沒有關係，
是因為你撐太久了。

那種累，
不是睡一覺就會好的。

它需要你——

真的躺下來，
不滑手機、不回訊息、
不思考下一步要怎麼辦，

就只是
讓自己
靜止一下。

地板真的很涼。

而且——

它從來不會催你起來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個倒下了還在硬撐、覺得「休息=罪惡」的朋友——地板很涼，躺一下沒關係，它不會催你起來
variations: 短版：既然都倒下了，就躺著吧——不一定要立刻爬起來
進階版：有些倒下不是因為你不夠強，是因為你撐太久了

en.content:
The most screenshotted line from Doctor Slump:

"Since you've already fallen down,
just lie there.

You don't have to get up right away.
You don't have to figure it out right now.

The floor is cool.
It's okay to lie there for a while."

I saw that line and froze for three seconds.

Because growing up,
no one ever said this to me.

They all said —

"If you fall, get up fast."
"Work harder."
"Everyone else can do it. Why can't you?"

As if falling down was shameful,
resting was running away,
"I can't do this anymore" was failure.

But as an adult you finally understand —

some falls
aren't because you weren't strong enough.
They're because you held it together for too long.

That kind of exhaustion
doesn't get fixed by one good sleep.

It needs you to —

actually lie down.
No phone. No replying to messages.
No planning what to do next.

Just
let yourself
be still.

The floor really is cool.

And —

it never rushes you to stand up.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who fell down and is still pushing through, who treats 'resting' like a sin — the floor is cool. It's okay. It won't rush you.
variations: Short: since you've already fallen down, just lie there — you don't have to get up right away
Advanced: some falls aren't because you weren't strong enough. They're because you held it together for too long.

items.sourceNote: 2026《愛情怎麼翻譯？》金宣虎高允貞溫柔終止主題延伸，原創親密關係觀察

zh-tw.content:
《愛情怎麼翻譯？》金宣虎那句話，
我看了三遍：

「溫柔，
是很可怕的東西。

一想到
有一天它會終止——

它就變成
世界上最可怕的東西。」

以前不懂這句話。

後來談過幾次戀愛之後，
才終於明白——

讓人崩潰的，
從來不會是「你對我不好」。

而是「你曾經對我這麼好」。

他以前會記得你不吃香菜，
會在你下班那條路上等你，
會聽你講你媽又煩了你什麼事。

後來他不記得了。
後來他不等了。
後來他在你講話到一半，
低頭滑手機。

你不是失去了一個人，
你是失去了——

那個曾經被他細心對待的自己。

所以溫柔最可怕的地方在於——

它讓你知道，
原來自己也可以被好好對待。

然後有一天
它消失了，
你就再也回不去
那個「不知道好是什麼樣子」的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個分手後一直走不出來、不知道自己在難過什麼的朋友——你不是失去一個人，你是失去那個被他好好對待的自己
variations: 短版：溫柔很可怕，因為一想到它會終止，就變成世界上最可怕的東西
進階版：你不是失去了一個人，你是失去了那個曾經被他細心對待的自己

en.content:
Kim Seon-ho's line in Can This Love Be Translated?
I watched it three times:

"Tenderness
is a terrifying thing.

The moment you realize
one day it will end —

it becomes
the most terrifying thing in the world."

I didn't understand this line at first.

Then after a few relationships,
I finally got it —

what breaks you
was never "you stopped being good to me."

It's "you used to be this good to me."

He used to remember you don't eat cilantro.
He used to wait at the corner near your office.
He used to listen to you complain about your mom.

Then he didn't remember.
Then he didn't wait.
Then he looked down at his phone
while you were mid-sentence.

You didn't lose a person.
You lost —

the version of yourself
that was once carefully looked after.

That's the scariest part of tenderness —

it shows you
that you can actually be treated well.

And one day
when it disappears,
you can't go back
to the version of you that didn't know what "good" felt like.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who can't get over the breakup and doesn't know what they're really mourning — you didn't lose a person. You lost the version of you that was once carefully looked after.
variations: Short: tenderness is terrifying because the moment you realize it will end, it becomes the most terrifying thing
Advanced: you didn't lose a person. You lost the version of yourself that was once carefully looked after.

items.sourceUrl: https://emilywei1027.com/雖然是精神病但沒關係
items.sourceNote: 經典韓劇《雖然是精神病但沒關係》信任主題2026重新流行，原創人際關係觀察
tags: 雖然是精神病但沒關係

zh-tw.content:
《雖然是精神病但沒關係》最近又被翻出來瘋傳的這句：

「真正的壞人，
不是會傷害你的人。

是——

不管你說什麼
他都不相信的人。」

第一次看的時候沒有感覺。

直到上週
我跟我媽吵了一架，
才終於懂了。

我說：
「媽，我最近真的壓力很大。」
她回：「年輕人能有什麼壓力。」

我說：
「我不是不想結婚，我是還沒準備好。」
她回：「你就是太挑了。」

我說：
「我喜歡我現在的工作。」
她回：「不要騙自己。」

那一刻我才發現——

傷害我最深的，
從來不是罵我的人。

是
從來不相信我的人。

是
我把心剖開來給他看，
他卻說
「你不是真的這樣想。」

那是一種——

比被打罵更深的孤單。

因為連你自己
說出來的話，
都已經
不被允許
是真的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直被家人否定情緒、覺得自己連感受都要先被審核的朋友——真正的傷害不是被罵，是說什麼都不被相信
variations: 短版：真正的壞人不是傷害你的人，是不管你說什麼都不相信你的人
進階版：最深的孤單不是被罵，是你說出來的話連自己都不被允許是真的

en.content:
The line from It's Okay to Not Be Okay that resurfaced lately:

"The truly bad person
is not the one who hurts you.

It's —

the one who doesn't believe you
no matter what you say."

First time I watched it, I felt nothing.

Then last week
I got into a fight with my mom
and suddenly I understood.

I said:
"Mom, I've been really stressed."
She said: "Young people don't have real stress."

I said:
"It's not that I don't want to get married. I'm just not ready."
She said: "You're just too picky."

I said:
"I actually like my job."
She said: "Don't lie to yourself."

That's when it hit me —

the deepest hurt
was never from the people who yelled at me.

It was
the people who refused to believe me.

The ones I opened my chest for
and they said
"that's not what you actually think."

That's —

a lonelier kind of loneliness
than being insulted.

Because even the words
you speak yourself
are no longer allowed
to be real.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend whose feelings get denied by family, who has to get their emotions pre-approved before they're allowed to feel them — the worst hurt isn't being yelled at. It's not being believed.
variations: Short: the truly bad person isn't the one who hurts you. It's the one who doesn't believe you no matter what you say.
Advanced: the deepest loneliness is when even the words you speak yourself aren't allowed to be real

items.sourceNote: 2026療癒系韓劇「家有人等」主題延伸，原創成年遊子的回家觀察

zh-tw.content:
2026 年最被傳閱的韓劇台詞之一：

「不管在外面
受了多少委屈，

只要想到
家裡還有人
等著你、愛著你，

就好像
又有力氣
面對明天了。」

我看完那一集，
打開冰箱，
看到我媽前天寄來的滷牛腱還沒吃完，

突然就哭了。

不是因為感動，
是因為——

我已經忘記，
上一次
「有人等我」的感覺
是什麼時候了。

租屋處沒有人。
手機沒有人。
下班路上沒有人。

你會慢慢習慣這種空，
習慣到
以為這就是正常。

直到那一塊牛腱
從冰箱裡看著你，

你才想起來——

原來「被等」這件事，
從來不是浪漫劇情，

是
大人世界裡，
最稀有的
生活必需品。

打電話回家。

不一定要講重要的事。

讓他們知道——

你也記得
他們在等。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一個人在外地、忘記家是什麼感覺的朋友——被等不是浪漫劇情，是成年人最稀有的生活必需品
variations: 短版：只要想到家裡還有人等著你，就好像又有力氣面對明天了
進階版：「被等」從來不是浪漫劇情，是大人世界裡最稀有的生活必需品

en.content:
One of the most-shared K-drama lines of 2026:

"No matter how much
the world hurts you out there,

the moment you remember
someone at home
is waiting for you, loving you,

it's like
you've got just enough strength
to face tomorrow again."

I finished that episode,
opened the fridge,
saw the braised beef shank my mom mailed me two days ago, still half-eaten,

and suddenly I was crying.

Not because I was moved.
Because —

I couldn't remember
the last time
the feeling of "someone is waiting for me"
was real.

No one in the apartment.
No one on the phone.
No one on the walk home.

You slowly get used to that emptiness.
Used to it enough
that you think it's just normal.

Until that piece of beef shank
looks back at you from the fridge,

and you remember —

being waited for
was never a romantic plot device.

It's
the rarest necessity
of adult life.

Call home.

You don't have to talk about anything important.

Just let them know —

you remember
they're waiting too.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend living alone in another city who's forgotten what 'home' feels like — being waited for isn't a romance trope. It's the rarest necessity of adult life.
variations: Short: the moment you remember someone at home is waiting for you, you have just enough strength to face tomorrow
Advanced: being waited for was never a romantic plot device. It's the rarest necessity of adult life.

items.sourceNote: 2026《莎拉的真偽人生》Netflix 春節爆紅，真相與謊言主題延伸，原創社群時代觀察

zh-tw.content:
《莎拉的真偽人生》那句被截圖瘋傳：

「真相像光一樣，
讓人難以直視；

謊言就像
美麗的晚霞，
為一切事物增色，

直到
被戳破為止。」

看到這句話，
我默默打開 Instagram。

滑了三分鐘。

看到那個朋友
上禮拜還在抱怨工作，
今天就 po 出咖啡廳精修照，
配文寫「感謝這份熱愛」。

看到那對情侶
上個月才剛吵到分房睡，
這個月就在峇里島合照，
配文寫「最好的我們」。

看到自己
昨天加班到崩潰，
今天還是 po 了一張陽光從窗戶灑進辦公室的照片，
配文寫「努力的人運氣不會太差」。

那一刻我突然懂了——

我們都不是在說謊。

我們只是
選了晚霞那一面
給別人看。

因為光的那一面
太刺眼了，
連自己都不敢看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一邊在 IG 假裝過得很好、一邊半夜偷哭的朋友——我們都不是在說謊，只是選了晚霞那一面給別人看
variations: 短版：真相像光一樣難以直視，謊言像晚霞美得讓人不想戳破
進階版：我們不是在說謊，只是選了晚霞那一面給別人看，因為光的那一面太刺眼了

en.content:
The screenshotted line from The Real Sara:

"Truth is like light —
hard to look at directly.

Lies are like
a beautiful sunset.
They color everything,

until
someone calls them out."

I read that line
and quietly opened Instagram.

Scrolled for three minutes.

Saw that friend
who was venting about work last week
post a perfectly edited cafe photo today,
caption: "grateful for this passion."

Saw that couple
who were sleeping in separate rooms last month
post a Bali couple photo this month,
caption: "the best version of us."

Saw myself
staying late and breaking down yesterday,
still posting a sunbeam-through-office-window shot today,
caption: "good things happen to people who try."

That's when it hit me —

none of us are lying.

We're just
showing people
the sunset side.

Because the light side
is too harsh.
Even we can't look at it.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend faking it on IG by day, crying at 2am by night — none of us are lying. We're just showing people the sunset side because the light side is too harsh to look at.
variations: Short: truth is like light, too harsh to look at. Lies are like sunsets, too pretty to call out.
Advanced: we're not lying. We're just showing people the sunset side, because the light side is too harsh — even for ourselves.

items.sourceNote: 2026台劇《影后》Netflix 主題延伸，「我有沒有電」自我覺察金句，原創都市疲憊觀察

zh-tw.content:
《影后》最後一集那句，
我被釘在沙發上五分鐘：

「我從來沒問過自己
還有沒有電。」

我才發現——

我會問手機有沒有電。
會問車子油還夠不夠。
會問另一半今天累不累。
會問同事這禮拜還撐得住嗎。

但我從來不問
自己
還剩多少電。

我醒著就工作。
累了就刷手機。
撐不住就喝咖啡。
崩潰就告訴自己
「再撐一下，週末就到了」。

週末到了。

我躺在床上滑手機，
累得連睡都睡不著，
然後星期一又再來一次。

我活得像
一台從來沒被插過電的手機，
靠著每天 5% 的剩餘電量
在運轉。

而我從來
沒有問過自己
還剩多少。

今晚——

請你
認真問一次自己：

「你還有電嗎？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直幫別人充電、卻從來沒檢查過自己電量的朋友——你問過手機、問過車子、問過所有人，今晚請認真問一次自己
variations: 短版：我從來沒問過自己還有沒有電
進階版：我活得像一台從來沒被插過電的手機，靠著每天 5% 的剩餘電量在運轉

en.content:
That line from the final episode of The Outstanding Actress
pinned me to the couch for five minutes:

"I've never once asked myself
if I still have battery left."

That's when I realized —

I ask if my phone is charged.
I ask if there's enough gas in the car.
I ask my partner if they're tired.
I ask coworkers if they can make it through the week.

But I never ask
myself
how much I have left.

I work when I'm awake.
I scroll when I'm tired.
I drink coffee when I'm collapsing.
I tell myself "hold on, the weekend's almost here"
when I'm breaking.

The weekend comes.

I lie in bed scrolling,
too exhausted to even sleep,
and then Monday starts again.

I'm living like
a phone that's never been plugged in,
running on the 5% it had left this morning.

And I've never
once asked
how much is left.

Tonight —

please
actually ask yourself:

"Do you still have battery?"
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who charges everyone else but never checks their own battery — you've asked your phone, your car, everyone. Tonight, actually ask yourself.
variations: Short: I've never once asked myself if I still have battery left
Advanced: I'm living like a phone that's never been plugged in, running on the 5% it had this morning.

items.sourceNote: Hometown Cha Cha Cha 洪斗植經典金句 2026 重新流行，原創成年人面對生活的觀察

zh-tw.content:
最近又被翻出來的洪斗植金句：

「就算撐傘，
還是會被淋濕。

那就
把手張開，
迎接這場雨。」

二十幾歲看這句，
覺得太浪漫。

三十幾歲再看，
才終於懂——

他不是在說雨。

他是在說
你已經反覆證明過的那件事：

再小心，
還是會被傷害。
再努力，
還是會被誤解。
再防備，
還是會碰到那個對你不好的人。

所以——

與其每天
抓著那把破洞的傘
還假裝沒事，

不如
承認自己會被淋濕。

然後
張開手。

讓雨
下完。

你會發現——

你以為會把你打濕到死的東西，
其實也只是
一場雨而已。

會停的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拚命撐傘還是被人生淋成落湯雞的朋友——你不是不夠小心，是雨太大。張開手，讓它下完，它會停
variations: 短版：就算撐傘還是會被淋濕，那就把手張開迎接這場雨
進階版：你以為會把你打濕到死的東西，其實也只是一場雨而已——會停的

en.content:
Hong Doo-shik's line from Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha resurfacing again:

"Even if you carry an umbrella,
you'll still get wet.

So just
open your hands
and welcome the rain."

In your twenties, it sounds too romantic.

In your thirties, you finally get it —

he's not talking about rain.

He's talking about
the thing you've already proven, over and over:

No matter how careful you are,
you still get hurt.
No matter how hard you try,
you still get misunderstood.
No matter how guarded you are,
you still meet the person who treats you badly.

So —

instead of
clutching a broken umbrella
and pretending you're dry,

just
admit that you're going to get wet.

Then
open your hands.

Let the rain
finish.

You'll realize —

the thing you thought would soak you forever
was, in the end,
just a rainstorm.

It stops.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend white-knuckling a broken umbrella through life's downpour — you're not careless. It's just heavy rain. Open your hands. It stops.
variations: Short: even with an umbrella you still get wet. Open your hands and welcome the rain.
Advanced: the thing you thought would soak you forever was, in the end, just a rainstorm. It stops.

items.sourceNote: 《苦盡柑來遇見你》IU 經典金句 2026 持續發酵，原創成年人撐不下去的觀察

zh-tw.content:
《苦盡柑來遇見你》那句
最近又被反覆截圖：

「總有一天
生活會難到
你以為自己撐不下去。

那時候——

不要躺著不動。

用盡力氣
掙扎。

告訴自己
不會死，
一定要活下去。

你會
再呼吸到的。」

以前看這句，
只覺得很文藝。

直到
那一天真的來了——

你才終於懂：

那不是文藝。
那是
一個經歷過的人
回頭來告訴你——

那種你以為過不去的東西，

會
過去。

只要
你還在
用力
掙扎。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個正在低谷裡撐著的朋友——不要躺著不動，用盡力氣掙扎。你會再呼吸到的
variations: 短版：總有一天生活會難到你以為自己撐不下去——那時候不要躺著不動，用盡力氣掙扎
進階版：那不是文藝，那是一個經歷過的人回頭告訴你——你以為過不去的，會過去

en.content:
The line from When Life Gives You Tangerines
that keeps getting screenshotted:

"One day
life will get so hard
you'll think you can't go on.

When that happens —

don't just lie there.

Struggle
with everything you have.

Tell yourself
you won't die.
You have to live.

You'll be able
to breathe again."

The first time you read it,
it sounds poetic.

Until
that day actually comes —

then you finally get it:

it's not poetry.
it's
someone who's been there
turning around to tell you —

that thing you think you can't survive,

will
pass.

As long as
you keep
struggling.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend white-knuckling their way through a hard season — don't just lie there. Struggle with everything. You'll breathe again.
variations: Short: one day life gets so hard you think you can't go on — when that happens, don't lie still. Struggle.
Advanced: it's not poetry. It's someone who's been there telling you — what you can't survive, you will.

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》金智媛金秀賢經典台詞 2026 重新流行，原創婚姻長久觀察

zh-tw.content:
《淚之女王》最近又被翻出來的那句：

「我以為
婚姻
是兩個人變成一個人。

後來才發現——

是兩個人
一起學會
怎麼當
兩個人。」

年輕的時候
談戀愛
總希望對方什麼都懂你、
什麼都跟你一樣。

後來才知道——

真正能走得遠的關係
不是
「我們完全一樣」，

而是——

你有你的怪，
我有我的怪，

但我們
願意
把對方的怪
當成這個家
獨有的風景。

婚姻不是
融合。

是
兩個完整的人
站在一起——

還願意
每天早上
再選一次
彼此。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那對結婚很多年但還是在學習怎麼相處的夫妻——婚姻不是融合，是兩個完整的人每天早上再選一次彼此
variations: 短版：婚姻不是兩個人變成一個人，是兩個人一起學會怎麼當兩個人
進階版：真正能走得遠的關係，是把對方的怪當成這個家獨有的風景

en.content:
The Queen of Tears line resurfacing again:

"I thought
marriage
was two people becoming one.

Later I learned —

it's two people
learning together
how to be
two people."

When you're young
you date hoping
the other person understands everything,
matches everything.

Later you learn —

the relationships that go the distance
aren't
"we're exactly the same."

They're —

you have your weirdness,
I have my weirdness,

and we're
willing
to treat each other's weirdness
as the unique scenery
of this home.

Marriage isn't
merging.

It's
two whole people
standing side by side —

still choosing
each other
every morning,
again.
en.editorNote: Send to the long-married couple still figuring out how to live together — marriage isn't merging. It's two whole people choosing each other again every morning.
variations: Short: marriage isn't two people becoming one. It's two people learning how to be two people, together.
Advanced: the relationships that last treat each other's weirdness as the unique scenery of the home

items.sourceNote: 《莎拉的真偽人生》申惠善經典金句 2026 病毒式傳播，原創相信與真相主題改寫

zh-tw.content:
《莎拉的真偽人生》最近
被截圖瘋傳的一句：

「人們
往往
把自己相信的東西，
當成
真相。」

第一次看到的時候
沒什麼感覺。

後來
才發現
它在說的是
你身邊每一場
吵不完的架——

父母
相信他們是為你好，
所以他們做的事就是
「真相」。

前任
相信你變了，
所以你說再多
都不是
「真相」。

網路上的陌生人
相信你應該長那樣，
所以你呈現的真實就被當成
「人設」。

原來——

讓人最痛的
從來與真相無關。

是
別人不願意
動搖
他們相信的版本，

所以
那個版本
就成了
你逃不掉的世界。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直在解釋自己卻沒人想聽的朋友——讓人最痛的從來不是真相，是別人不願意動搖他們相信的版本
variations: 短版：人們往往把自己相信的東西，當成真相
進階版：讓人最痛的從來不是真相，是別人不願意動搖他們相信的版本

en.content:
The line from The Real Has Come
that keeps getting screenshotted:

"People
often
treat what they believe
as
the truth."

The first time you read it
it doesn't land.

Later
you realize
it's describing
every unwinnable argument
in your life —

your parents
believe they're acting out of love,
so whatever they do
becomes
"the truth."

Your ex
believes you changed,
so nothing you say
ever becomes
"the truth."

Strangers online
believe you should look a certain way,
so what you actually are
gets dismissed as
"performance."

Turns out —

what hurts most
is never the truth.

It's
that other people
won't
let go
of the version they believe,

and so
that version
becomes
the world you can't escape.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps explaining themselves to people who won't listen — what hurts isn't the truth. It's people refusing to let go of the version they already believe.
variations: Short: people often treat what they believe as the truth
Advanced: what hurts most isn't the truth. It's other people refusing to let go of the version they believe

items.sourceNote: 2026 韓劇療癒系金句，主題「等待」與自我價值，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
最近被瘋傳的一句：

「不要

把
等待，

誤會成
愛。」

他說再給他一點時間——
你等。
他說現在還不是時候——
你等。
他說等他忙完這陣子——
你還是等。

你以為
等得越久，
證明你越愛。

但真相是——

會讓你
一直等的人，

從來
沒打算
讓你
等到。

愛你的人
不會
讓你
站在原地
猜
他到底
來不來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是在等一個人「準備好」的朋友——會讓你一直等的人，從來沒打算讓你等到
variations: 短版：不要把等待，誤會成愛
進階版：愛你的人不會讓你站在原地，猜他到底來不來

en.content:
The line everyone's resharing:

"Don't

mistake
waiting

for
love."

He says give him a little more time —
you wait.
He says now isn't the right moment —
you wait.
He says once this busy stretch is over —
you wait some more.

You think
the longer you wait,
the more it proves you love him.

But the truth is —

someone who keeps you
waiting

never
intended
for the wait
to end.

Someone who loves you
won't leave you
standing in one spot
guessing
whether he's
coming at all.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend always waiting for someone to be 'ready' — the person who keeps you waiting never planned for the wait to end
variations: Short: don't mistake waiting for love
Advanced: someone who loves you won't leave you standing there guessing whether he's coming

items.sourceNote: 2026 台劇親情主題金句，「父母與子女」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡那句讓全場安靜的：

「我們

總是
對最親的人，

用
最差的
語氣。」

對同事客氣，
對朋友耐心，
對陌生人都記得說謝謝。

回到家——

媽多問一句
你就嫌煩，
爸關心一下
你就不耐，
那個最不會離開你的人，
反而
承接了
你一整天
累積的脾氣。

因為你知道
他們
不會走，

所以你
把最壞的自己
留給了
最不該
受傷的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個對外人總是很好、回家卻沒耐心的你——我們把最壞的自己，留給了最不該受傷的人
variations: 短版：我們總是對最親的人，用最差的語氣
進階版：因為你知道他們不會走，所以你把最壞的自己留給了他們

en.content:
The drama line
that silenced the whole room:

"We always

save
our worst tone

for the people
closest
to us."

Polite to coworkers,
patient with friends,
you even thank strangers without thinking.

Then you get home —

Mom asks one extra question
and you snap.
Dad checks in on you
and you sigh.
The person least likely to leave
ends up absorbing
a whole day's
built-up irritation.

Because you know
they won't go,

you hand
your worst self
to the people
who deserve
to be hurt
least.
en.editorNote: For the version of you that's lovely to outsiders but impatient at home — we save our worst self for the people who deserve it least
variations: Short: we always save our worst tone for the people closest to us
Advanced: because you know they won't leave, you hand them your worst self

items.sourceNote: 2026 韓劇職場主題金句，「努力與被看見」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡有一句太現實：

「沒被看見的

努力，

不是
沒有
價值，

是
還沒
遇到
對的人
看。」

你加的班
沒人記得，
你補的洞
沒人知道，
你扛下的事
換來一句
「這不是本來就該做的嗎」。

你開始懷疑——
是不是
努力
根本
沒用。

沒有這回事。

是你
一直
在一個
看不見你的地方
發光。

換個地方——

同樣的你，
會被
當成
寶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個努力卻一直不被看見的朋友——不是你不夠好，是你在一個看不見你的地方發光
variations: 短版：沒被看見的努力，不是沒價值，是還沒遇到對的人看
進階版：換個地方，同樣的你，會被當成寶

en.content:
A K-drama line that's painfully real:

"Effort

that goes
unseen

isn't
worthless —

it just
hasn't met
the right person
to see it
yet."

The overtime
no one remembers,
the gaps
you quietly filled,
the weight you carried
repaid with
'wasn't that just your job?'

You start to wonder —
maybe
trying
doesn't
matter
at all.

It does.

You've just been
shining
in a place
that can't
see you.

Somewhere else —

the same you
would be
treasured.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend whose effort keeps going unnoticed — it's not that you're not good enough, you're shining where no one can see you
variations: Short: unseen effort isn't worthless — it just hasn't met the right person to see it
Advanced: somewhere else, the same you would be treasured

items.sourceNote: 2026 韓劇友情主題金句，「漸行漸遠」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
最近被狂截圖的一句：

「有些朋友

不是
吵架
才散的，

是
慢慢
沒話
才散的。」

沒有誰對不起誰，
沒有翻臉，
沒有刪好友。

只是——

他有了新的生活圈，
你有了新的煩惱，
訊息
從
秒回
變成
已讀，
從
已讀
變成
不讀。

你們
不是
絕交，

是
剛好
走到了
人生
不同的
路口。

有些人
只能
陪你
走一段，

那一段
還是
真的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個曾經無話不談、現在卻不知道從何說起的老朋友——有些人只能陪你走一段，但那一段還是真的
variations: 短版：有些朋友不是吵架才散的，是慢慢沒話才散的
進階版：你們不是絕交，是剛好走到了人生不同的路口

en.content:
The line everyone keeps screenshotting:

"Some friendships

don't end
in a fight.

They end
in a slow
running
out of
things to say."

No one wronged anyone,
no falling out,
no unfollowing.

It's just —

he found a new circle,
you found new worries,
messages
went
from
instant replies
to
left on read,
from
left on read
to
never opened.

You didn't
cut each other off.

You simply
reached
different
forks
in life.

Some people
only walk
part of the way
with you,

and that part
was still
real.
en.editorNote: Send to the old friend you once told everything to but now don't know where to begin — some people only walk part of the way with you, and that part was still real
variations: Short: some friendships don't end in a fight — they end in a slow running out of things to say
Advanced: you didn't cut each other off, you just reached different forks in life

items.sourceNote: 2026 台劇自我成長主題金句，「討好別人」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡那句點醒人的：

「你

那麼
怕
讓人
失望，

結果
最
失望
你的，

是
你
自己。」

別人開口你不會拒絕，
別人有事你第一個答應，
別人不開心你急著道歉——
哪怕
根本
不是
你的錯。

你把每個人
都照顧好了，

只有
那個
累到
說不出話的你，

沒人
問
一句
累不累。

你可以
善良，

但
別
善良到
把自己
弄丟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠把別人放第一、卻把自己放最後的朋友——你可以善良，但別善良到把自己弄丟
variations: 短版：你那麼怕讓人失望，結果最失望你的，是你自己
進階版：你把每個人都照顧好了，只有那個累到說不出話的你，沒人問一句累不累

en.content:
The drama line
that snaps you awake:

"You're

so afraid
of letting
people down,

the one
most
let down
by you,

is
you."

You never say no when asked,
you're first to volunteer,
you rush to apologize when someone's upset —
even
when it
wasn't
your fault.

You took care
of everyone,

and the only one
too drained
to speak —

that version of you —

no one
asked
if you were
tired.

You can be
kind,

but don't be
so kind
you lose
yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always puts everyone first and themselves dead last — you can be kind, just don't be so kind you lose yourself
variations: Short: you're so afraid of letting people down, the one most let down by you is you
Advanced: you took care of everyone; the only one no one asked about was you

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》婚姻主題金句，「等待」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡關於「等待」的一句話，戳中很多人：

「如果
你一直
在等
一個人，

等到
連
自己
都
覺得
可悲，

那
就
不是
愛了，

是
執著。」

愛
會
讓你
變得
更好，

執著
只會
讓你
一點一點
弄丟
自己。

分得清
這兩件事，
你
才
真正
長大。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個還在等一個不會回頭的人的朋友——愛讓你變好，執著只會讓你弄丟自己
variations: 短版：如果等一個人等到連自己都覺得可悲，那就不是愛了，是執著
進階版：愛會讓你變得更好，執著只會讓你一點一點弄丟自己

en.content:
A drama line about waiting that hits a lot of people:

"If you've been
waiting
for someone

until even
you
feel
pathetic
about it,

then
it isn't
love
anymore.

It's
attachment."

Love
makes you
better.

Attachment
just makes you
lose
yourself,
piece
by piece.

Knowing
the difference
is what
growing up
really means.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend still waiting on someone who's never coming back — love makes you better, attachment just makes you lose yourself
variations: Short: if waiting for someone makes even you feel pathetic, it's not love — it's attachment
Advanced: love makes you better; attachment just makes you lose yourself piece by piece

items.sourceNote: 《魷魚遊戲》信任主題金句，「相信是一種選擇」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡關於「信任」的一段，越想越有道理：

「人
會
相信
一個人，

不是
因為
那個人
值得
相信，

是
因為
他們
相信，

沒有
別人
可以
依靠
了。」

信任
從來
不是
別人
給你
的
保證，

是
你
自己
做
的
選擇。

你
要是
關上
心門，
誰
都
進
不來，

你
就
只能
一個人
站
在
世界
中間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被傷過、從此不敢再相信任何人的朋友——信任是選擇，關上心門誰都進不來
variations: 短版：信任不是別人給你的保證，是你自己做的選擇
進階版：你要是關上心門，誰都進不來，就只能一個人站在世界中間

en.content:
A K-drama take on trust that makes more sense the more you sit with it:

"People
don't trust
someone

because
that person
is worth
trusting.

They trust
because
they believe

there's
no one
else
left
to lean on."

Trust
was never
a guarantee
someone
handed you.

It's
a choice
you
make.

Close
the door
to your heart
and no one
gets in —

and you're
left
standing
in the middle
of the world
alone.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who got hurt and now refuses to trust anyone — trust is a choice; close that door and no one gets in
variations: Short: trust isn't a guarantee someone hands you — it's a choice you make
Advanced: close the door to your heart and you're left standing in the world alone

items.sourceNote: 《八尺門的辯護人》父子對話金句，「站在陸地上才知道自己在搖晃」原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，後勁很強：

「討海
的人
都是
拚命
的，

你
能
比
他們
還
狠
嗎？

只有
站
在
陸地
上，

才
知道
自己
一直
在
搖晃。」

你
以為
自己
很
穩，

是
因為
你
沒
離開
過
那片
海。

真正
看清
自己，

往往
是
停
下來
的
那
一刻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直往前衝、從沒停下來看自己的朋友——只有停下來，才知道自己一直在搖晃
variations: 短版：只有站在陸地上，才知道自己一直在搖晃
進階版：你以為自己很穩，是因為你沒離開過那片海

en.content:
This line from a Taiwanese drama lingers:

"People
who work
the sea
all fight
for their lives —

could you
ever be
as
relentless
as them?

It's only
when you
stand
on land

that you
realize
you'd been
swaying
the whole
time."

You think
you're
steady —

but only
because
you never
left
that sea.

The moment
you truly
see
yourself

is usually
the moment
you
stop.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps charging ahead and never pauses to look at themselves — only when you stop do you realize you'd been swaying all along
variations: Short: it's only when you stand on land that you realize you'd been swaying the whole time
Advanced: you think you're steady only because you never left that sea

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》婚姻與愛情金句延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡關於愛情的這段，越長大越懂：

「真正
的
喜歡，

不是
他
有
多
完美，

是
你
在
他
面前，

可以
當
那個
不
完美
的
自己。」

你
不用
裝，

不用
撐，

不用
隨時
保持
最好
的
樣子。

累
了
可以
說
累，

哭
了
不用
解釋。

那
才是
愛
讓人
安心
的
地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在感情裡一直很累、總覺得要表現完美才會被愛的人——對的人面前，你可以不完美
variations: 短版：真正的喜歡，是你在他面前可以當那個不完美的自己
進階版：累了可以說累，哭了不用解釋，那才是愛讓人安心的地方

en.content:
A K-drama take on love that hits harder the older you get:

"Real
love

isn't
about
how
perfect
they are.

It's
that
around
them

you get
to be
the
imperfect
version
of
yourself."

No
performing.

No
holding
it
together.

No
staying
at your
best
every
second.

Tired?
You can
say so.

Crying?
No
explanation
needed.

That's
where
love
feels
like
safety.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who's exhausted in their relationship, always thinking they have to be perfect to be loved — with the right person, you get to be imperfect
variations: Short: real love is being able to be the imperfect version of yourself around them
Advanced: tired? you can say so. crying? no explanation needed. that's where love feels like safety

items.sourceNote: 《請回答吧》系列家人主題金句延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇《請回答吧》這段，看一次哭一次：

「家人
之間
不
說
抱歉，

也
不
說
謝謝，

因為
那些
話
太
見外。」

他們
不會
說
我
愛
你，

只會
問
你
吃
飽
沒。

他們
不會
說
我
擔心，

只會
唸
你
怎麼
這麼
晚
回。

那些
說
不
出口
的
話，

全
藏
在
一桌
還
熱
著
的
飯
裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟家人不太會說愛、卻彼此都懂的人——說不出口的話，都藏在一桌熱飯裡
variations: 短版：家人之間不說抱歉也不說謝謝，因為那些話太見外
進階版：那些說不出口的話，全藏在一桌還熱著的飯裡

en.content:
This bit from the K-drama Reply series — I cry every single time:

"Family
doesn't
say
sorry,

and
doesn't
say
thank
you,

because
those words
feel
too
formal
between
them."

They won't
say
'I love
you' —

they'll
ask
if you've
eaten.

They won't
say
'I was
worried' —

they'll
scold you
for
coming
home
so late.

All the
words
they can't
say

are hidden
in a table
of food
they kept
warm
for you.
en.editorNote: Send to someone whose family never says 'I love you' out loud but somehow both of you know — the unsaid words are hidden in a table of food kept warm for you
variations: Short: family doesn't say sorry or thank you — those words feel too formal between them
Advanced: all the words they can't say are hidden in a table of food they kept warm for you

items.sourceNote: 《Bon Appetit, Your Majesty》(2025)「想你因為餓還是餓因為想你」金句延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡最會撩的一句：

「我是因為餓了才想你，
還是因為想你才覺得餓？」

反正每到吃飯時間，
第一個想到的就是你。

看到好吃的想分你一半，
吃到難吃的想叫你別來踩雷。

後來才發現，
我想的不只是吃飯，
是想跟你一起吃飯。

一個人的餐桌再豐盛，
都不如你坐在對面隨便聊兩句。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你總想揪一起吃飯的人——所有的「吃飽沒」其實都是「我想你」
variations: 短版：我是因為餓了才想你，還是因為想你才覺得餓？
進階版：我不是想吃飯，是想跟你一起吃飯

en.content:
The smoothest line in any K-drama:

"Am I thinking of you because I'm hungry,
or am I hungry because I'm thinking of you?"

Either way, every time it's mealtime,
you're the first thing on my mind.

See something good, I want to share half with you.
Eat something bad, I want to warn you off it.

Turns out
I don't actually want to eat —
I want to eat with you.

The fanciest table set for one
still loses to you across from me,
talking about nothing.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you always want to grab a meal with — every 'have you eaten?' is secretly 'I miss you'
variations: Short: am I thinking of you because I'm hungry, or hungry because I'm thinking of you?
Advanced: I don't actually want to eat — I want to eat with you

items.sourceNote: 《When Life Gives You Tangerines》(2025)「愛的大小一樣，差的是溫度」金句延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇這句，把愛說得太準了：

「愛的大小其實一樣，
不一樣的是溫度。」

有人愛你愛得很大聲，
有人愛你愛得很安靜。

有人把愛說成稱讚，
有人把愛藏進嘮叨。

小時候不懂，
以為唸你的人不愛你，
長大才知道，
那是最不會說好聽話的愛。

真正暖到你的，
從來不靠漂亮話，
是那份剛剛好的溫度——
讓你可以安心做自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被家人嘮叨長大、現在才慢慢讀懂的人——愛的大小一樣，差別只在表達的溫度
variations: 短版：愛的大小其實一樣，不一樣的是溫度
進階版：真正暖到你的，是那份剛剛好的溫度，讓你可以安心做自己

en.content:
This K-drama line nails what love really is:

"The size of the love was the same.
What differed was its temperature."

Some people love you loudly.
Some people love you quietly.

Some turn love into praise.
Some hide love inside nagging.

As a kid you didn't get it —
you thought the one scolding you
didn't love you.
Growing up, you learned
that was just love
with no talent for sweet words.

What actually warms you
isn't how beautifully it's said.
It's that just-right temperature —
the one that lets you be yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to someone raised on a parent's nagging who's only now learning to read it — the love was the same size, only the temperature differed
variations: Short: the size of the love was the same — what differed was its temperature
Advanced: what actually warms you is that just-right temperature, the one that lets you be yourself

items.sourceNote: 2026療癒韓劇「快樂只有自己能給」金句延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇這句，建議貼在鏡子上：

「自己的快樂，
永遠只有自己能給，
別把幸福的決定權
交到別人手上。」

等別人來愛你才開心，
那你的開心就會一直缺貨。

等別人說你好，你才覺得好，
那你永遠在等一句不一定會來的話。

你可以喜歡有人陪，
但不要變成沒人陪就活不下去。

先把自己過得快樂，
別人來，是加分；
別人不來，你也已經很完整。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個習慣把開心寄託在別人身上的朋友——幸福的遙控器，要握在自己手裡
variations: 短版：別把幸福的決定權交到別人手上
進階版：別人來是加分，別人不來，你也已經很完整

en.content:
A K-drama line worth taping to your mirror:

"Your own happiness
can only ever come from you.
Don't hand the power
over your joy to someone else."

Wait for someone to love you before you're happy,
and your happiness stays out of stock.

Wait for someone to call you good
before you feel good,
and you're forever waiting on a line
that may never come.

You're allowed to enjoy company —
just don't become someone
who can't survive without it.

Build a happy life first.
When people show up, that's a bonus.
When they don't, you're already whole.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who tends to pin their happiness on other people — keep the remote control to your own joy in your own hand
variations: Short: don't hand the power over your joy to someone else
Advanced: when people show up that's a bonus — when they don't, you're already whole

items.sourceNote: 韓劇愛情金句「愛不是甜言蜜語，是一起撐過痛」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇這段，重新定義了什麼叫愛：

「愛跟天天甜言蜜語沒有關係，
是難關來的時候，
你選擇留下，而不是逃走。」

熱戀時誰都會說好聽話，
那不算什麼。

真正的考驗，
是日子變難、人變累、
連笑都笑不太出來的時候，
你還願不願意伸手牽他。

會說「我愛你」的人很多，
願意在你最狼狽時
還站在你旁邊的，很少。

你要找的，是後面那種。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在猶豫一段關係值不值得的朋友——甜的時候誰都在，難的時候還在，才是真的
variations: 短版：愛不是甜言蜜語，是難關來時你選擇留下
進階版：會說我愛你的人很多，願意在你最狼狽時還站在旁邊的，很少

en.content:
This K-drama line redefines what love actually is:

"Love isn't whispering sweet nothings every day.
It's choosing to stay
when the hard part arrives —
instead of running."

Anyone can say pretty things
in the honeymoon phase.
That part is easy.

The real test
is when life gets heavy,
when you're both worn out,
when even smiling takes effort —
and they still reach for your hand.

Plenty of people will say 'I love you.'
Few will stand beside you
at your messiest.

Look for the second kind.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend weighing whether a relationship is worth it — anyone stays for the sweet part; staying through the hard part is the real thing
variations: Short: love isn't sweet nothings — it's choosing to stay when the hard part arrives
Advanced: plenty will say 'I love you'; few will stand beside you at your messiest

items.sourceNote: 《低谷醫生》治癒金句「現在不順又不會一輩子不順」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《低谷醫生》這句，低潮的時候很需要：

「沒事的，
我們只是現在不順，
又不是一輩子都這樣。
抬頭挺胸，
好事很快就會來。」

人在谷底的時候，
最容易把「暫時」看成「永遠」。

但你低潮，不代表你失敗，
只代表你正在過一段比較難走的路。

路會轉彎，
季節會換，
你現在卡住的事，
半年後回頭看，可能根本不算什麼。

先撐著，別急著下結論。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在覺得一切都卡住的人——現在不順，不等於一輩子不順，只是這段路比較難走
variations: 短版：我們只是現在不順，又不是一輩子都這樣
進階版：你現在卡住的事，半年後回頭看，可能根本不算什麼

en.content:
A line from 'Doctor Slump' you'll want on a rough day:

"It's okay.
We're just not doing well right now —
not forever.
Chin up.
Good things are coming soon."

When you're at the bottom,
it's so easy to mistake
'for now' for 'always.'

But a low patch isn't failure.
It just means
you're walking a harder stretch of road.

Roads bend.
Seasons turn.
The thing that has you stuck today
might mean nothing
when you look back in six months.

Hold on. Don't rush to conclusions.
en.editorNote: Send to someone who feels like everything is stuck — being in a slump isn't failing, it's just a harder stretch of the same road
variations: Short: we're just not doing well right now — not forever
Advanced: what has you stuck today might mean nothing six months from now

items.sourceNote: 韓劇愛情金句「治癒不是抹去痛，是給你再愛的力氣」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇這句，給剛走出一段感情的人：

「治癒，
從來不在把那些痛全部抹掉，
而在讓你有力氣，
再去愛一次。」

很多人以為療傷
就是要徹底忘記，
忘到提起來都沒感覺。

但其實不用。
那段痛可以一直在，
它只是慢慢變成你的一部分，
不再痛得讓你動不了。

你不需要假裝沒受過傷，
你只需要，
哪天再遇到一個對的人時，
還有勇氣把手伸出去。

那就是你已經好了的證明。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在走出一段感情、卻怪自己「還沒放下」的人——治癒不是忘記，是你還願意再愛一次
variations: 短版：治癒不是抹去痛，是讓你有力氣再愛一次
進階版：你不用假裝沒受過傷，只要再遇到對的人時，還敢把手伸出去

en.content:
A K-drama line for anyone just out of a relationship:

"Healing
isn't erasing all the pain.
It's having the strength
to love again."

A lot of people think mending
means forgetting completely —
forgetting until it stirs nothing at all.

But you don't have to.
The ache is allowed to stay.
It just slowly becomes
part of you —
no longer the kind that freezes you in place.

You don't need to pretend
you were never hurt.
You only need,
when the right person comes along someday,
the courage to reach out anyway.

That's the proof you've healed.
en.editorNote: Send to someone moving on from a breakup but blaming themselves for 'not being over it' — healing isn't forgetting, it's being willing to love again
variations: Short: healing isn't erasing the pain — it's the strength to love again
Advanced: you don't have to pretend you were never hurt — you just need the courage to reach out when the right person comes

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《苦盡柑來遇見你》金句「醬汁發酵後味道更好，人生要經歷過才知道甘苦」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，給覺得自己過得太苦的人：

「醬料要先發酵，
味道才會變深。

人生也是，
要先嚐過苦的，
才知道什麼叫甘。」

你現在覺得難熬的這段，
沒有在拖累你，
它在替你醃。

那些難睡的夜、
說不出口的委屈、
咬牙撐過的關卡，
都會慢慢沉下去，
變成你身上別人學不來的味道。

再等等，
還沒到開封的時候。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在低潮、覺得「為什麼是我」的朋友——他的苦不是被浪費，是在熟成
variations: 短版：你不是在受苦，你是在發酵
進階版：再難熬的這段都會沉下去，變成別人學不來的味道——還沒到開封的時候

en.content:
A K-drama line for anyone who feels life has been too bitter:

"Sauce has to ferment first
before the flavor deepens.

Life is the same.
You taste the bitter
before you know what sweet means."

This hard stretch you're in
isn't dragging you down —
it's curing you.

The sleepless nights,
the hurt you couldn't say out loud,
the walls you gritted your teeth to climb —
they all slowly settle,
turning into a flavor no one else can copy.

Wait a little longer.
It isn't time to open the jar yet.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend in a slump asking 'why me' — their hardship isn't wasted, it's aging into something
variations: Short: you're not suffering, you're fermenting
Advanced: every hard stretch settles into a flavor no one else can copy — the jar just isn't ready yet

items.sourceNote: 台劇《想見你》電影版金句「去愛，去失去，要不負相遇」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，給捨不得放手的人：

「去愛，
去失去，
要不負相遇。」

我們總想抓住一個人，
抓到連對方都喘不過氣，
好像只要不放手，
就不算失去。

但相遇本來就有期限，
你能做的，
從來與「別結束」無關，
是讓它值得。

所以好好愛，
真的愛過了，
哪天要說再見，
你才不會覺得白來這一趟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在愛情裡患得患失、害怕失去的人——也可以收藏給未來要道別的自己
variations: 短版：相遇有期限，你能做的不是讓它不結束，是讓它值得
進階版：真的愛過了，哪天說再見，才不會覺得白來這一趟

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who can't let go:

"Love.
Lose.
Just don't waste the meeting."

We always try to hold someone
so tightly they can barely breathe,
as if never letting go
means never losing them.

But every meeting comes with an expiry date.
What you can do
isn't to keep it from ending —
it's to make it worth it.

So love well.
If you truly loved,
then on the day you say goodbye,
you won't feel the whole thing was for nothing.
en.editorNote: Send to someone anxious in love and terrified of loss — or save it for the future self who'll one day have to say goodbye
variations: Short: every meeting expires — your job isn't to stop the ending, it's to make it worth it
Advanced: if you truly loved, then saying goodbye won't feel like the whole thing was for nothing

items.sourceNote: 台劇《我們與惡的距離》金句「到底什麼是好人？什麼是壞人？你有標準答案嗎？」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，問得人說不出話：

「到底什麼是好人？
什麼是壞人？
你有標準答案嗎？」

我們太習慣
把人分成兩邊：
喜歡的就是好人，
討厭的就是壞人。

好像只要貼上標籤，
世界就會簡單一點。

但真實的人沒那麼乾淨，
好人也會做錯事，
你討厭的人也有人深愛著。

承認這件事很難，
可是當你願意停下來，
先去理解再去評斷，
你就比昨天的自己，
善良了一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在社群論戰、急著替別人定罪的時刻轉發——提醒大家先理解，再評斷
variations: 短版：好人也會做錯事，你討厭的人也有人深愛著
進階版：先去理解再去評斷，你就比昨天的自己善良了一點

en.content:
A drama line that leaves you speechless:

"What exactly makes a good person?
A bad one?
Do you have a standard answer?"

We're so used to
splitting people into two camps:
the ones we like are good,
the ones we hate are bad.

As if a label
makes the world a little simpler.

But real people aren't that clean.
Good people do wrong things,
and the person you can't stand
is deeply loved by someone.

Admitting that is hard.
But the moment you're willing to pause,
to understand before you judge,
you become a little kinder
than you were yesterday.
en.editorNote: Good to share during online pile-ons or when everyone's rushing to convict someone — a reminder to understand before judging
variations: Short: good people do wrong things, and the person you hate is deeply loved by someone
Advanced: understand before you judge, and you become a little kinder than you were yesterday

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《淚之女王》婚姻與愛情金句延伸，關於相愛卻學不會好好說話的主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這段，給結了婚卻越來越沉默的兩個人：

「對外人，
我把每句話當情書，
字字斟酌。

對最親的人，
我卻像在廢紙上亂塗，
想到什麼說什麼，
從不在意會不會痛。」

我們總是這樣，
對陌生人客氣，
對愛人隨便。

好像越親的人，
就越不用解釋，
越可以把情緒倒給他。

但他不是因為該被這樣對待，
他只是因為愛你，
才一直忍著。

別把最好的耐心，
都給了不重要的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給總是對外人客氣、對另一半沒耐心的人——提醒對方，最親的人最值得好好說話
variations: 短版：別把最好的耐心都給了不重要的人
進階版：他不是該被這樣對待，他只是因為愛你，才一直忍著

en.content:
A K-drama passage for two people who married and slowly went silent:

"With strangers,
I treat every sentence like a love letter,
weighing each word.

With the person closest to me,
I scribble on scrap paper —
say whatever comes to mind,
never caring if it stings."

We always do this:
polite to strangers,
careless with the ones we love.

As if the closer someone is,
the less we owe them an explanation,
the more we can dump our moods on them.

But they don't deserve to be treated that way.
It's only because they love you
that they keep enduring it.

Don't give your best patience
to the people who matter least.
en.editorNote: Send to someone who's gracious with strangers but short with their partner — a reminder that the closest person deserves your kindest words
variations: Short: don't give your best patience to the people who matter least
Advanced: they don't deserve to be treated that way — it's only because they love you that they keep enduring it

items.sourceNote: 台劇《此時此刻》金句延伸，關於每個人都值得被愛的主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，給覺得自己不夠好的人：

「全世界只有一個你，
沒有第二個，
光憑這點，
就值得被愛。」

你總在比較，
比別人瘦一點、會說話一點、
成功一點，
好像要先變得更好，
才配得到喜歡。

可是這世界上
再也找不到第二個你了，
你的笨拙、你的脾氣、
你笑起來的樣子，
都是限量款。

不必變得更好才值得，
你本來就值得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得自己不夠好、要先優秀才敢被愛的人——提醒他光是存在就有價值
variations: 短版：全世界只有一個你，光憑這點就值得被愛
進階版：不是變得更好才值得，是你本來就值得

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who thinks they're not enough:

"There's only one of you
in the whole world,
no second copy —
and that alone
makes you worth loving."

You keep measuring yourself:
a little thinner, a little smoother,
a little more successful,
as if you have to become better
before you deserve to be liked.

But nowhere on this earth
is there a second you —
your clumsiness, your temper,
the way you laugh,
all of it a limited edition.

You're not worth it after you improve.
You were worth it all along.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who feels they must be impressive before they can be loved — a reminder that simply existing makes them valuable
variations: Short: there's only one of you in the world, and that alone makes you worth loving
Advanced: you're not worth it after you improve — you were worth it all along

items.sourceNote: 台劇《此時此刻》金句延伸，「不管世界多殘忍，我們都值得最好的愛情」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，給在愛裡受過傷的人：

「不管這個世界
有多殘忍，
我們都值得
最好的愛情。」

被辜負過的人
常常會降低標準，
覺得有人要就好，
不被討厭就偷笑。

可是將就來的感情，
填不滿你心裡那個洞，
只會讓你越愛越委屈。

你不是難搞，
你只是還沒遇到
那個願意把你放在第一位的人。

等，是值得的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被傷過、開始覺得自己不配好愛情的人——提醒他別急著將就
variations: 短版：不管世界多殘忍，我們都值得最好的愛情
進階版：你不是難搞，你只是還沒遇到願意把你放第一位的人

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who's been hurt in love:

"No matter how cruel
this world is,
we all deserve
the best kind of love."

People who've been let down
often lower the bar —
thinking it's enough if someone wants them,
grateful just not to be disliked.

But love you settled for
won't fill the hole inside you;
it only makes you ache more the harder you try.

You're not difficult.
You just haven't met
the person willing to put you first.

The wait is worth it.
en.editorNote: Send to someone who's been hurt and started believing they don't deserve a good love — a reminder not to rush into settling
variations: Short: no matter how cruel the world is, we all deserve the best kind of love
Advanced: you're not difficult — you just haven't met the person willing to put you first

items.sourceNote: 台劇《此時此刻》金句延伸，「每個食材都有最適合的料理方式，人也是」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，給覺得自己被放錯位置的人：

「每種食材
都有最適合的料理方式，
人也是，
我們都該被放在
對的位置上。」

你不是不夠好，
你只是被擺錯了地方。

同一個人，
在這裡被嫌格格不入，
換個環境
卻可能閃閃發光。

別急著否定自己，
有時候問題不在你，
是這裡的鍋
不適合炒你這道菜。

找到對的位置，
你會比誰都耀眼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在現在的環境裡懷疑自己、覺得處處格格不入的人——提醒他可能只是位置不對
variations: 短版：你不是不夠好，你只是被擺錯了地方
進階版：有時候不是你的問題，是這裡的鍋不適合炒你這道菜

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who feels out of place:

"Every ingredient
has the cooking method that suits it best.
So do people —
we all deserve to be placed
where we belong."

You're not lacking.
You've just been put in the wrong spot.

The same person
called a misfit here
might shine somewhere else entirely.

Don't rush to doubt yourself.
Sometimes it isn't you —
it's just that this kitchen
wasn't built to cook your dish.

Find the right place
and you'll outshine everyone.
en.editorNote: Send to someone questioning themselves in their current environment, feeling like a misfit — a reminder it may just be the wrong spot
variations: Short: you're not lacking — you've just been put in the wrong spot
Advanced: sometimes it isn't you; this kitchen just wasn't built to cook your dish

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句主題「情緒生病像感冒一樣正常」，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，給最近一直撐著的人：

「心情會生病，
就跟感冒一樣，
沒什麼好丟臉的。」

你不會因為感冒
就罵自己軟弱，
那為什麼
難過的時候
要這樣對自己？

身體累了會發燒，
心累了
當然也會有徵兆。

別硬撐成沒事的樣子，
允許自己
好好生一場病，
才有力氣
慢慢好起來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總把「我沒事」掛嘴邊、其實已經快撐不住的人——提醒他情緒生病不丟臉
variations: 短版：心情會生病，就跟感冒一樣，沒什麼好丟臉的
進階版：你不會因為感冒就罵自己軟弱，難過的時候也別這樣對自己

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who's been holding it together:

"Your heart can get sick too,
just like catching a cold.
There's nothing shameful about it."

You don't call yourself weak
for catching a cold —
so why
do you do it
when you're sad?

A tired body runs a fever.
A tired heart
has its own warning signs too.

Stop forcing the 'I'm fine' face.
Let yourself
be properly unwell —
that's the only way
you'll find the strength to heal.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who keeps saying 'I'm okay' while barely hanging on — a reminder that a sick heart is nothing to be ashamed of
variations: Short: your heart can get sick too, just like a cold — there's nothing shameful about it
Advanced: you don't call yourself weak for catching a cold, so don't do it when you're sad

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句「剛好遇到下雨天，雨停了就好」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，給覺得自己最近特別倒霉的人：

「當你想著
為什麼倒霉的總是我，
請記得——
你沒有做錯什麼，
只是剛好
遇到了下雨天。」

雨不是針對你下的，
它只是路過，
剛好淋到你而已。

你不需要
在淋雨的時候
還檢討自己是不是哪裡不好。

撐著一下，
雨總會停，
停了之後
地上會反光，
你會看見
自己其實走得很遠了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個最近諸事不順、開始懷疑是不是自己問題的人——提醒他有時候只是剛好遇到下雨天
variations: 短版：你沒有做錯什麼，只是剛好遇到了下雨天，雨停了就好
進階版：雨不是針對你下的，它只是路過，剛好淋到你而已

en.content:
A drama line for anyone feeling unusually unlucky lately:

"When you catch yourself thinking
'why is it always me' —
remember:
you didn't do anything wrong.
You just
ran into a rainy day."

The rain isn't aimed at you.
It's just passing through,
and you happened to be standing there.

You don't have to
stand in the downpour
and interrogate what's wrong with you.

Hold on a little longer.
The rain always stops,
and when it does
the ground will shine —
and you'll see
how far you've actually come.
en.editorNote: Send to someone hitting a rough patch who's started blaming themselves — a reminder that sometimes you just ran into a rainy day
variations: Short: you didn't do anything wrong — you just ran into a rainy day, and it'll pass
Advanced: the rain isn't aimed at you; it's just passing through, and you happened to be there

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《苦盡柑來遇見你》金句「人生會繼續，像新長出來的指甲」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，給卡在過不去的那件事裡的人：

「人生還是會繼續，
就像剪掉的指甲
又會重新長出來，
每一天
都是新的一天。」

你以為
那道傷會跟你一輩子，
可身體
從來沒打算停下來等你。

細胞每天在更新，
昨天哭過的你
和今天的你，
其實已經
不是同一個人了。

不用急著好起來，
光是
你還願意過明天，
就已經
在慢慢長出新的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被某件事困住、覺得人生停在原地的人——提醒他身體和日子都還在往前長
variations: 短版：人生還是會繼續，像剪掉的指甲又長出來，每一天都是新的一天
進階版：昨天哭過的你和今天的你，其實已經不是同一個人了

en.content:
A drama line for anyone stuck on something they can't get past:

"Life keeps going anyway,
like a nail
you cut
growing back —
every day
is a new day."

You think
the wound will stay with you forever,
but your body
never planned to stop and wait for you.

Cells renew every day.
The you who cried yesterday
and the you of today
aren't even
the same person anymore.

Don't rush to be okay.
Just the fact
that you're willing to face tomorrow
means you're already
growing a new self, quietly.
en.editorNote: Send to someone trapped by one event, feeling like life has stalled — a reminder that their body and their days are still growing forward
variations: Short: life keeps going, like a cut nail growing back — every day is a new day
Advanced: the you who cried yesterday and the you of today aren't even the same person anymore

items.sourceNote: 台劇《此時此刻》金句「戀愛就像一場重感冒，它來過，但也會消失」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，送給正在為一段感情心痛的人：

「愛情
就像一場重感冒。

它來的時候
讓你發燒、失眠、
滿腦子都是那個人；

但你要相信，
再重的感冒
也會好。」

現在你覺得
好像永遠走不出來，
那是因為
你還在發燒。

再撐一陣子，
有一天你會發現
自己已經能
好好吃飯、好好睡覺，
聽到那首歌
也不會再鼻酸。

你沒有忘了他，
你只是終於
退燒了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛失戀、覺得自己再也好不了的朋友——告訴他這只是還在發燒，總有退燒的一天
variations: 短版：愛情就像一場重感冒，再重也會好，你只是還在發燒
進階版：不是你忘了他，是你終於退燒了

en.content:
A drama line for anyone aching over someone right now:

"Love
is like a bad fever.

When it hits,
it burns you up — sleepless,
that person flooding every thought;

but trust this:
even the worst fever
breaks eventually."

Right now it feels
like you'll never get past it.
That's only because
you're still running a fever.

Hold on a little longer.
One day you'll notice
you can eat again,
sleep again,
and that one song
doesn't sting anymore.

It's not that you forgot them.
It's that the fever
finally broke.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend who just got their heart broken and feels they'll never recover — tell them it's just a fever, and fevers always break
variations: Short: love is like a bad fever — even the worst one breaks, you're just still burning up
Advanced: it's not that you forgot them, it's that the fever finally broke

items.sourceNote: 台劇《不夠善良的我們》金句「人性很滑稽，沒有得到的永遠更迷人」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，送給那個總是羨慕別人的人：

「人性
是不是很滑稽？

沒有得到的，
永遠
更迷人。」

你手上握著的，
你覺得理所當然；
別人擁有的，
你覺得閃閃發光。

但其實
那個你羨慕的人，
可能正在羨慕你。

他想要你的安穩，
你想要他的自由；
他羨慕你有人陪，
你羨慕他一個人也很好。

沒得到的之所以迷人，
是因為
你只看到它的好，
還沒看到它的代價。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得別人的人生比較好、一直在比較的朋友——提醒他得不到的東西總是被濾鏡美化了
variations: 短版：人性很滑稽，沒有得到的永遠更迷人
進階版：沒得到的之所以迷人，是因為你只看到它的好，還沒看到它的代價

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who keeps envying others:

"Isn't human nature
ridiculous?

Whatever we didn't get
always looks
more alluring."

What's already in your hands
you take for granted;
what someone else has
looks like it's glowing.

But here's the thing —
the person you envy
is probably envying you.

They want your stability,
you want their freedom;
they envy that you have someone,
you envy that they're fine on their own.

The reason the thing you didn't get
looks so alluring
is that you only see its upside,
not yet the price it carries.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always thinks someone else's life looks better and can't stop comparing — a reminder that what we don't have is always filtered to look prettier
variations: Short: human nature is ridiculous — whatever we didn't get always looks more alluring
Advanced: the thing you didn't get looks alluring because you only see its upside, not its price

items.sourceNote: 台劇《不夠善良的我們》金句「很多事你不面對，就不會成為過去」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
台劇裡這句，送給那個一直假裝沒事的人：

「很多事，
你不面對，
它就不會
成為過去。」

你把那件外套
塞到衣櫃最裡面，
前面擋了三件冬衣，
拉鍊朝內，
連換季都跳過那一格。

你以為看不見
就等於好了。

可是每年拿羽絨衣，
手指總會先碰到它，
你會停半秒，
再假裝那半秒
沒有發生過。

哪天你敢把它拿出來，
攤在床上看完，
承認它壓過你的胸口，
再折好、送出去，
衣櫃才會真的空出
那一格的位置。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直逃避某件事、假裝自己已經沒事的朋友——提醒他不面對的事永遠不會變成過去
variations: 短版：很多事你不面對，它就不會成為過去
進階版：你願意面對的那一天，才是它真正結束的那一天

en.content:
A drama line for anyone who keeps pretending they're fine:

"So many things —
until you face them,
they'll never
become the past."

You think
not thinking about it means letting go,
but really
you've just buried it
somewhere out of sight.

It didn't disappear.
It just picks another hour —
usually the middle of the night —
to jump out
and wake you up.

Real letting go
isn't running.
It's looking at the thing
properly,
admitting it hurt,
and then
placing it, with your own hands,
into the drawer marked 'past.'

The day you're willing to face it
is the day
it truly ends.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps avoiding something and pretending they're over it — a reminder that what you won't face never becomes the past
variations: Short: until you face it, it'll never become the past
Advanced: the day you're willing to face it is the day it truly ends

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《我們的浪漫電影》「我想安慰你而不是說教，我想理解你而不是責備你」金句延伸，原創改編成現代陪伴觀察

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，送給那個總是想替別人解決問題的人：

「我想安慰你，
不想對你說教。
我想理解你，
不想責備你。」

你在餐桌上說了一句
「我最近有點撐不住」。

有人立刻接：
「那你就早點睡啊。」
「你要不要換個工作？」
「我早就跟你說過了。」

只有一個人
把手機翻過去蓋著，
把湯推到你面前，
說：
「你先吃，
吃完再講。」

會給建議的人排到門口，
願意先把嘴閉上的
只有那一個。

別把他弄丟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總愛在你難過時急著給建議的人——溫柔提醒：有時候陪伴比解決問題更重要
variations: 短版：我想安慰你，不是對你說教；想理解你，不是責備你
進階版：會說教的人到處都是，願意先閉嘴聽你講完的人才是真的在乎

en.content:
A drama line for the person who always tries to fix everyone's problems:

"I want to comfort you,
not lecture you.
I want to understand you,
not blame you."

When you're hurting,
the last thing you need
is a sentence
that starts with 'you should...'

In that moment
you don't want answers.
You want someone
sitting beside you
saying,
'I get it. This is really hard.'

People who lecture
are everywhere.
The person willing to stay quiet
and let you finish
is the one who actually cares.

You can pretend
you feel nothing about your own wounds —
just don't ignore
the person who keeps staying by your side.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who rushes to give advice the moment you're upset — a gentle reminder that sometimes being present matters more than fixing it
variations: Short: I want to comfort you, not lecture you; understand you, not blame you
Advanced: people who lecture are everywhere — the one who stays quiet and listens is the one who cares

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《夢想成為律師的律師們》「連自己都無法辯護，怎麼為別人辯護」金句延伸，原創改編成現代自我價值觀察
tags: 夢想成為律師的律師們

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，送給那個對別人很好、卻對自己很差的人：

「連你自己
都無法為自己辯護，
你又怎麼
為別人辯護？」

你會替朋友據理力爭，
會替同事抱不平，
會為陌生人
打一整晚的字討公道，

可是輪到自己被欺負，
你卻先說
「算了，是我太敏感」。

你把所有的溫柔
都發給別人，
唯獨忘了
你也值得
有人站出來幫你說話——

而那個人，
第一個應該是你自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是替別人出頭、卻從不為自己爭取的朋友——提醒他先學會替自己辯護
variations: 短版：連你自己都無法為自己辯護，又怎麼為別人辯護？
進階版：你把所有溫柔都發給別人，卻忘了第一個該替你說話的人是你自己

en.content:
A drama line for the person who's kind to everyone but cruel to themselves:

"If you can't even
defend yourself,
how can you
defend anyone else?"

You'll argue the case for a friend,
stand up for a coworker,
type all night
to win justice for a stranger —

but the moment
you're the one being wronged,
you say,
'Forget it, I'm just being too sensitive.'

You hand out all your kindness
to other people
and somehow forget
that you also deserve
someone in your corner —

and that someone
should be you, first.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always sticks up for others but never for themselves — a reminder to learn to defend their own corner first
variations: Short: if you can't defend yourself, how can you defend anyone else?
Advanced: you give all your kindness to others and forget the first person who should speak up for you is you

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《夢想成為律師的律師們》「有時陌生人給予的愛，比親人更深厚」金句延伸，原創改編成現代關係觀察
tags: 夢想成為律師的律師們

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡這句，可能會戳到某些人：

「人們總以為
血濃於水，
於是對至親的傷害
視而不見、充耳不聞。

但有時候，
陌生人給的愛，
比親人
還要深厚。」

沒有人規定
傷你最深的人
就有資格被原諒，

也沒有人規定
陪你走過最難那段路的人
一定要有血緣。

家人是緣分，
但溫柔是選擇。

那個願意選你的人，
不管有沒有血緣，
都值得你
好好放在心上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在原生家庭裡受過傷、卻被朋友溫柔接住的人——提醒他：愛不一定來自血緣，被好好對待從來不是奢求
variations: 短版：家人是緣分，但溫柔是選擇
進階版：傷你最深的人不會因為血緣就有資格被原諒，陪你走過最難的人也不一定要有血緣

en.content:
A drama line that might hit close to home:

"People assume
blood is thicker than water,
so they look away
from the harm done by their own kin.

But sometimes
the love a stranger gives
runs deeper
than family ever did."

No rule says
the person who hurt you most
is owed forgiveness
just because you share a name.

And no rule says
the person who walked you
through your hardest stretch
had to be related to you.

Family is chance.
Kindness is a choice.

The person who chooses you —
blood or not —
is the one
worth keeping close.
en.editorNote: Send to someone hurt by their family but caught gently by their friends — a reminder that love doesn't require blood, and being treated well was never too much to ask
variations: Short: family is chance, but kindness is a choice
Advanced: no one is owed forgiveness just for sharing your name, and the person who carried you through didn't have to be related

items.sourceNote: Netflix台劇《影后》金句整理，演藝圈現實主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《影后》裡最狠的一句，是說給所有還在等的人聽的：

「你先成個咖，
才有資格在這裡掉眼淚。」

你在後台哭的那一次，
沒有人遞面紙給你，
場務從你旁邊走過去，
搬走了三支腳架。

你難過得很認真，
可是那天的通告單上
沒有你的名字。

等你哪天站上台了，
同樣一滴眼淚
會被拍成三個角度，
隔天有人替你寫成一整篇文章。

很殘忍，
可是它從頭到尾
都沒有騙過你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在努力卻還沒被看見的朋友——不是潑冷水，是提醒他現在的隱忍都不會白費
variations: 短版：你先成個咖，才有資格在這裡掉眼淚
進階版：你還沒被看見時，委屈只是你自己的事；站上台了，同一滴眼淚才有人解讀

en.content:
The cruelest line in 'Born for the Spotlight' is for everyone still waiting:

"Become somebody first —
then you've earned the right
to cry here."

It's not telling you not to hurt.
It's that this industry
has no time to watch you hurt.

While no one sees you yet,
your pain
is your business alone.
The moment you make it to the stage,
that same single tear
is suddenly something
people rush to interpret.

Is it brutal? Deeply.
But it isn't lying to you.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend grinding away unseen — not to discourage them, but to remind them none of this quiet endurance is wasted
variations: Short: become somebody first, then you've earned the right to cry here
Advanced: unseen, your pain is yours alone; on the stage, that same tear is something everyone rushes to interpret

items.sourceNote: 《影后》柯麗芬「人與人的關係要用減法去算」金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《影后》裡這句，年紀越大越懂：

「到了某個歲數才發現，
人跟人之間的關係，
是用減法在算的。」

二十五歲那年，
你的通訊軟體有四百多個好友，
一年跑十二場婚禮，
每一場都笑得很用力。

三十五歲這年，
你常開的群組剩三個，
其中一個是家人，
一個只在生日那天亮起來。

半夜會接你電話的
剩下兩個人。

那兩個，
就是你算了十年
才算出來的答案。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給最近在整理人際關係、覺得朋友變少卻更自在的人——告訴他那不是退步，是篩選
variations: 短版：人跟人的關係是用減法在算的，留下來的那幾個才是答案
進階版：減法不是失去，是把力氣還給真的值得的人

en.content:
A line from 'Born for the Spotlight' that hits harder with age:

"You reach a certain age and realize —
relationships between people
are counted by subtraction."

When you're young
you collect friends,
chase being needed,
show up at every gathering,
as if a longer list
means less lonely.

Later you understand
the handful
who actually stayed
are the answer.

Subtraction isn't loss —
it's giving your energy
back
to the people who deserve it.
en.editorNote: Send to someone pruning their social circle who feels lighter with fewer friends — tell them it's not a step back, it's filtering
variations: Short: relationships are counted by subtraction — the few who stayed are the answer
Advanced: subtraction isn't loss, it's giving your energy back to the people who deserve it

items.sourceNote: 《影后》「對自己沒信心時就大聲唸得獎感言」金句延伸，演藝圈勵志主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《影后》教我的一招，比任何心靈雞湯都實用：

「對自己沒信心的時候，
就大聲把得獎感言
唸出來。」

她把浴室的門關上，
熱水開著，
鏡子起霧，
她用手抹出一個橢圓。

她清了清喉嚨，
對著霧裡那個自己
說謝謝。

謝謝公司，
謝謝導演，
謝謝那個當年
差點就放棄的自己。

沒有掌聲，
只有排風扇在轉。

她講完，
擦乾手，
出門去試鏡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給明天要面試、報告、上台的朋友——叫他對著鏡子先唸一遍得獎感言，騙過自己的大腦
variations: 短版：對自己沒信心的時候，就大聲把得獎感言唸出來
進階版：自信不是等來的，是先演出來，演著演著就成真了

en.content:
A trick 'Born for the Spotlight' taught me, more useful than any pep talk:

"When you've lost faith in yourself,
read your acceptance speech
out loud."

Sounds cringey,
but try it and you'll see —

stand in front of the mirror,
pretend you've already won the award,
thank all the support
that hasn't happened yet,
and your body
believes it first,
your brain
catches up after.

Confidence isn't something you wait for.
You act it out first,
and somewhere in the acting
it becomes real.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend with an interview, presentation, or stage moment tomorrow — tell them to read their acceptance speech to the mirror and trick their own brain
variations: Short: when you've lost faith in yourself, read your acceptance speech out loud
Advanced: confidence isn't something you wait for — you act it out first, and somewhere in the acting it becomes real

items.sourceNote: 《此時此刻》『做自己』金句方向，原創改寫成自我接納語錄，非原台詞照抄

zh-tw.content:
《此時此刻》最戳人的一句話：

「你不用逼自己
變成一個快樂的人，
你只要
做你自己就好。」

我們花了好多年，
學著表演開心、
練習正能量、
把難過藏進笑容裡——

結果越演越累，
因為那個快樂的人，
根本不是你。

後來才懂，
不快樂的時候，
允許自己不快樂，
才是真正對自己好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是「我沒事啦」的朋友——告訴他，不用一直假裝沒事，難過也可以光明正大地難過
variations: 短版：你不用逼自己變快樂，你只要做你自己就好
進階版：不快樂的時候，允許自己不快樂，才是真正對自己好

en.content:
The line from this drama that hits the deepest:

"You don't have to force yourself
to be a happy person.
You just have to
be yourself."

We spent years
learning to perform cheerfulness,
practicing good vibes,
tucking the sadness behind a smile —

and the harder we acted,
the more exhausted we got,
because that happy person
was never actually us.

Later you realize:
when you're not okay,
letting yourself not be okay
is the real way to be kind to yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always says 'I'm fine' — tell them they don't have to keep pretending, sadness is allowed to be out in the open too
variations: Short: you don't have to force yourself to be happy, you just have to be yourself
Advanced: when you're not okay, letting yourself not be okay is the real way to be kind to yourself

items.sourceNote: 2026台劇《人生只租不賣》租屋族題材，原創改寫成租屋人生對照語錄

zh-tw.content:
看《人生只租不賣》才發現，租屋根本是人生縮影：

「押兩付一」= 還沒開始，就先掏空存款
「屋況請自行確認」= 你只能賭，不能怪
「房東說不能養寵物」= 你的快樂要先報備
「合約到期不續租」= 沒做錯什麼，只是被換掉了
「水電瓦斯自付」= 看不見的成本最傷

最戳的一句台詞：
「這間房子不是你的，
但你在這裡哭過、笑過、撐過，
那段日子
就是你的。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給正在外地打拚、住在小套房裡的朋友——租來的房子，活出來的人生是真的
variations: 短版：房子是租來的，但你在裡面撐過的那段日子，是你的
進階對照：「房東要賣房請搬遷」= 你的安穩，從來不在你手上

en.content:
Watching this renters' drama, you realize renting is basically life in miniature:

"Two months deposit, one month up front" = drained before you even begin
"Inspect the unit yourself" = you can gamble, but you can't complain
"Landlord says no pets" = your happiness needs prior approval
"Lease won't be renewed" = you did nothing wrong, you just got replaced
"Utilities not included" = the invisible costs hurt the most

The line that lands hardest:
"This place isn't yours,
but you cried here, laughed here, got through here —
and that stretch of time
is yours."
en.editorNote: Forward to the friend grinding away in a faraway city, living in a tiny studio — the apartment is rented, but the life you live in it is real
variations: Short: the place is rented, but the days you got through inside it are yours
Advanced parallel: 'Landlord is selling, please move out' = your stability was never in your hands

items.sourceNote: 台劇《影后》演員/自我懷疑題材金句方向，原創改寫成自我價值語錄

zh-tw.content:
《影后》裡有一句話，
我反覆看了好幾遍：

「我不是怕輸，
我是怕
連自己都不相信自己了。」

比起別人的否定，
更可怕的是
那個在心裡偷偷說
「我大概不行吧」的聲音。

它不大聲，
但它最常贏。

所以記得：
你可以累、可以慌、
可以暫時演不下去，
但別第一個
放棄你自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在懷疑自己撐不撐得下去的人——別人怎麼看是其次，先別讓自己背叛自己
variations: 短版：我不是怕輸，我是怕連自己都不相信自己了
進階版：你可以累、可以慌，但別第一個放棄你自己

en.content:
There's a line in this drama
I rewound several times:

"I'm not afraid of losing.
I'm afraid of the day
I stop believing in myself too."

Worse than other people's doubt
is that quiet little voice inside
that whispers
"I probably can't do this."

It's never loud,
but it wins the most often.

So remember:
you're allowed to be tired, to panic,
to lose the thread for a while —
just don't be
the first one
to give up on yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to someone doubting whether they can keep going — what others think comes second, just don't betray yourself first
variations: Short: I'm not afraid of losing, I'm afraid of the day I stop believing in myself too
Advanced: you're allowed to be tired and scared — just don't be the first one to give up on yourself

items.sourceNote: 2026台劇《接招吧！製作人》音樂產業職人題材，原創改寫成創作者語錄

zh-tw.content:
《接招吧！製作人》裡，
前輩對快撐不下去的新人說：

「一首歌會不會紅，
你決定不了。
但你有沒有用力，
只有你自己知道。

市場很現實，
運氣很隨機，
可是那些真正打動人的東西，
從來騙不了人。

你先把歌做好，
剩下的，
交給時間。」

獻給所有
在沒人看見的地方
還在認真做事的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那個默默經營作品、還沒被看見的創作者朋友——紅不紅是運氣，但你有沒有用力，騙不了自己
variations: 短版：你決定不了一首歌紅不紅，但你有沒有用力，只有你自己知道
進階版：你先把事情做好，剩下的交給時間

en.content:
In this music-industry drama,
a veteran tells a rookie who's about to quit:

"Whether a song blows up
is not yours to decide.
But whether you gave it everything —
only you know that.

The market is brutal,
luck is random,
but the things that truly move people
have never been able to fake it.

Make the song good first.
The rest,
leave it to time."

For everyone
still doing the work
in a place where no one's watching.
en.editorNote: Forward to the creator friend quietly building something that hasn't been seen yet — going viral is luck, but whether you gave it everything, you can't fool yourself on that
variations: Short: you can't decide if a song blows up, but whether you gave it everything, only you know
Advanced: make the work good first, and leave the rest to time

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句，原創改寫：承認自己只想當普通人不丟臉

zh-tw.content:
八歲那年，你在作文簿上寫：長大要當很厲害的人。

三十歲這天，你在便利商店結帳，
買了一顆茶葉蛋和一瓶牛奶，
想著等一下要早點睡。

沒有變厲害，
但今天的飯有好好吃完，
今天的澡有好好洗，
明天還會準時起床。

這樣就算過關了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那個總覺得「我是不是太沒出息」的朋友——把普通的生活撐住，本身就很了不起
variations: 短版：能把平凡的日子穩穩過下去，就已經是一種厲害
進階：不是每個人都要發光，有人負責把日子過好，世界才不會塌

en.content:
As a kid I thought growing up meant becoming someone impressive.
Turns out,
just keeping an ordinary life running
takes everything I've got.

Admitting I don't want to be a hero —
that I just want to eat well, sleep well, get through the day —
isn't giving up.
It's finally letting myself off the hook.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps asking if they're 'falling behind' — holding an ordinary life together is already an achievement
variations: Short: keeping an ordinary life steady is its own kind of strong
Advanced: not everyone has to shine — someone keeps the days running, and that's why the world holds

items.sourceNote: 淚之女王愛情觀改寫：愛不是甜言蜜語，是一起撐過痛苦

zh-tw.content:
愛情不是天天說好聽的話，
也不是永遠開心。

真正的愛，
是兩個人一起把難關熬過去，
是在最想轉身離開的時候，
選擇留下來。

甜蜜誰都會，
能一起吃苦的，才算數。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給結婚多年、最近有點疲憊的另一半——提醒彼此，能一起撐過來的才是真的
variations: 短版：能陪你熬過爛日子的，才是對的人
情話版：開心的時候誰都在，難過的時候我還在，這就是我給你的答案

en.content:
Love isn't sweet words every day,
and it isn't being happy all the time.

Real love
is two people getting through the hard parts together —
choosing to stay
right when you most want to walk away.

Anyone can do the sweet stuff.
The ones who'll suffer alongside you — those are the ones that count.
en.editorNote: For the partner of many years who's been a little worn out lately — a reminder that getting through it together is what's real
variations: Short: the right person is the one who stays through your worst days
Sweet version: anyone shows up for the good times — I'm still here for the bad ones, and that's my answer

items.sourceNote: 海岸村恰恰恰下雨意象改寫：人生會淋濕，乾脆張開手迎接雨

zh-tw.content:
人生總會碰上你沒準備好的時刻，
就算撐了傘，
還是會被淋濕。

與其一直閃，
不如張開手，
好好接住這場雨。

反正都會濕，
那就濕得痛快一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給最近事情接二連三出包、快被生活淋透的朋友——擋不住的時候，換個心態反而沒那麼狼狽
variations: 短版：擋不住的雨，就張開手接吧
進階：人生很多事不是你準備好它才來，學會被淋濕也是一種本事

en.content:
Life always hands you moments you weren't ready for.
Even with an umbrella,
you'll still get soaked.

Instead of dodging forever,
open your arms
and take the rain.

You're getting wet either way —
so get wet on your own terms.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend hit by one thing after another, soaked through by life — when you can't block it, a shift in attitude makes it less miserable
variations: Short: the rain you can't dodge — open your arms and take it
Advanced: life doesn't wait until you're ready — learning to get drenched is a skill too

items.sourceNote: 請回答1988親情金句改寫：家人是最晚說出口、最遲被理解的愛

zh-tw.content:
你回家那天，桌上有一鍋湯，火關掉了，鍋蓋還是燙的。

冰箱門上貼著你上禮拜隨口說想吃的東西，
用原子筆寫在藥袋背面。

他們會為了你機車沒牽好，罵你十分鐘，
會嫌你頭髮太長、衣服穿太少，
唸完又把水果切好推到你面前。

那些難聽的話底下，藏的全是怕你過得不好。

趁那鍋湯還熱著，多回家幾趟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給很久沒回家、或最近跟爸媽鬧彆扭的人——家人的愛常常包在難聽的話裡，別等聽懂了才後悔
variations: 短版：他們罵你的每一句，底下都是怕你過不好
進階：家人的愛總是最晚被聽懂，趁來得及，多打幾通電話

en.content:
Family doesn't mean never fighting.
It means that after the fight,
they still leave a light on and a bowl of rice for you.

Their way of loving you is clumsy —
often scolding, nagging, brushing it off with a 'dress warmer.'
But underneath all the harsh words
is just the fear that you're not okay.

The day you finally understand
is usually a little too late —
so while there's still time, go home a few more times.
en.editorNote: Send to someone who hasn't been home in a while, or is sulking at their parents — family love often comes wrapped in harsh words; don't wait until you get it to regret
variations: Short: every harsh word they throw at you is really just fear that you're struggling
Advanced: family love is always understood last — while there's still time, make a few more calls

items.sourceNote: 2026療癒系韓劇金句改寫：幸福的決定權不該交給別人，自己的快樂只有自己能給

zh-tw.content:
你的快樂，從來只有你自己給得起。

你今天笑不笑，別交到別人手上——
他已讀不回，你一整天做什麼都提不起勁；
他回一張貼圖，你才敢覺得自己還可以。

那不叫愛，那叫把生活的遙控器交出去。

你要先能一個人把週末過得像樣，
別人出現的時候，
才會是加分，而不用當救命。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那種「對方已讀不回就世界崩塌」的朋友——溫柔提醒她，幸福的遙控器要握在自己手上
variations: 短版：別把幸福的開關交給別人，他心情不好你也跟著沒命
進階：先把自己過好，別人是加分題，不是必考題

en.content:
Your happiness has only ever been yours to give.

Don't hand the switch to someone else —
you only laugh when he's in a good mood,
one word from him and your whole day is wrecked.

That's not love. That's handing over your life.

Learn to be okay on your own first.
Then whether someone shows up
becomes a bonus, not a rescue.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend whose whole world collapses over a left-on-read text — a gentle reminder that the remote to her happiness belongs in her own hand
variations: Short: don't hand your happiness switch to someone else, or his bad mood becomes your death sentence
Advanced: get yourself right first — other people are extra credit, not a required exam

items.sourceNote: 《莎拉的真偽人生》金句改寫：人們往往以為自己相信的就是真相

zh-tw.content:
人最危險的，
不是不知道真相，
是太確定自己知道。

你相信的，未必是事實，
常常只是你「想要」它是事實。

那些看起來冷靜講道理的人，
話裡藏的往往不是真相，
是他們最不想被看穿的慾望。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配《莎拉的真偽人生》劇照轉發，或寫在被人帶風向、急著下定論的時刻——提醒自己先別急著相信
variations: 短版：你以為的真相，常常只是你想要的版本
進階：講得最理直氣壯的人，藏得最深的往往是私心

en.content:
The most dangerous thing about people
isn't not knowing the truth —
it's being so sure they already know it.

What you believe isn't always what's real.
Often it's just what you want to be real.

The ones who sound calm and reasonable —
what's hidden in their words usually isn't truth.
It's the desire they least want you to see.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a still from the show, or post it the moment a narrative is being spun — a reminder to slow down before you believe
variations: Short: the truth you assume is often just the version you wanted
Advanced: the person who sounds the most righteous is usually hiding the deepest agenda

items.sourceNote: 《以家人之名》成長金句改寫：真正的長大是一瞬間的事，沒人會發現

zh-tw.content:
長大不是滿十八歲那天發生的。

那天你只是法律上的大人，
心裡可能還是個孩子。

真正長大，
往往是某個很普通的瞬間——
你突然扛起了某件事，
突然懂了爸媽的某句話，
突然不再哭著等人來救。

沒有人會發現，
只有你自己知道：
從那一刻起，你不一樣了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給最近被生活壓得喘不過氣、卻默默撐住的人——長大是一個人偷偷完成的事，給他一句「我看見了」
variations: 短版：真正長大是某個普通瞬間，沒人發現，只有你自己知道
進階：你不是十八歲那天長大的，是某次扛下了不該你扛的事那天

en.content:
Growing up doesn't happen on your eighteenth birthday.

That day you're only an adult on paper —
inside, you might still be a kid.

Real growing up
usually arrives in some ordinary moment —
you suddenly carry something heavy,
you suddenly understand a thing your parents once said,
you suddenly stop crying and waiting to be saved.

No one notices.
Only you know:
from that moment, you were never the same.
en.editorNote: Send to someone quietly holding it together under the weight of life — growing up is done alone and unseen; give them a 'I noticed'
variations: Short: real growing up happens in some ordinary moment no one sees — only you know
Advanced: you didn't grow up at eighteen; you grew up the day you carried something that was never yours to carry

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇《戀愛實用指南》金句改寫：現代人不再等命運來牽線
