zh-tw.content:
電影裡的愛情，
總是從一場命中註定的相遇開始。

現實裡的我們，
早就不等命運了——
命運太慢，
而且常常派錯人。

與其等那個對的人從天而降，
不如先把自己活成想遇見的樣子。
緣分這種東西，
你站著不動，它也懶得理你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合單身但不焦慮的朋友群組——愛情可以期待，但別把人生交給命運外送，自己先動起來
variations: 短版：命運太慢又常派錯人，不如自己先活成想遇見的樣子
進階：緣分不會找站著不動的人，先動起來它才會路過

en.content:
In the movies, love always starts
with a fated, destined encounter.

In real life, we stopped
waiting on fate a long time ago —
fate is slow,
and it keeps sending the wrong person.

Instead of waiting for the right one to fall from the sky,
become the person you'd want to meet.
As for serendipity —
if you just stand there, it can't be bothered with you either.
en.editorNote: Good for the group chat of friends who are single but not stressed about it — you can hope for love, just don't outsource your life to fate; move first
variations: Short: fate is slow and keeps sending the wrong person — become who you'd want to meet instead
Advanced: serendipity skips the people standing still; move first and it'll pass by

items.sourceNote: 《流星花園》金句改寫：愛情像黑咖啡，苦，但讓你長大、給你下次的勇氣

zh-tw.content:
愛情有點像黑咖啡。

第一口都是苦的，
苦到你以為這輩子再也不碰。

可是過一陣子，
你會懷念那個味道——
不是因為它不苦了，
是因為那場苦，
讓你長大了一點，
也讓你有了下一次的勇氣。

所以別怕苦，
喝過的人才知道，
甜不是重點，醒過來才是。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛失戀、還在說「再也不要談了」的人——苦過才會懂，那杯黑咖啡其實在幫你長大
variations: 短版：愛情像黑咖啡，苦過才長大，也才有下一次的勇氣
進階：別怕苦，喝過的人才知道，甜不是重點，醒過來才是

en.content:
Love is a little like black coffee.

The first sip is always bitter —
so bitter you swear you'll never touch it again.

But after a while
you start to miss the taste —
not because it stopped being bitter,
but because that bitterness
grew you up a little,
and gave you the courage for a next time.

So don't fear the bitter.
Only those who've drunk it know:
sweet isn't the point — waking up is.
en.editorNote: Send to someone fresh out of a breakup still swearing 'never again' — you only get it once you've tasted the bitter; that black coffee is quietly growing you up
variations: Short: love is black coffee — the bitterness grows you up and gives you courage for next time
Advanced: don't fear the bitter; only those who've drunk it know sweet isn't the point — waking up is

items.sourceNote: 《鬼怪》孔劉告白台詞改寫：與你在一起的每個時刻都閃閃發光，天氣好壞都好

zh-tw.content:
和你在一起的每一個瞬間，
都在發光。

天氣好的時候，發光，
天氣不好的時候，也發光，
天氣剛剛好的時候，更發光。

後來我才懂，
會發光的從來不是天氣，
是你站在那裡的樣子。

我喜歡的不是哪一天，
是有你的每一天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想告白又不想太肉麻的時候用——把「我愛你」換成「有你的每天都在發光」，含蓄但殺傷力十足
variations: 短版：會發光的不是天氣，是你站在那裡的樣子
進階：我喜歡的不是哪一天，是有你的每一天

en.content:
Every single moment with you
is shining.

It shines when the weather is good,
it shines when the weather is bad,
and when the weather is just right, it shines even more.

Later I understood —
it was never the weather doing the shining.
It was the way you stood there.

What I love isn't any one day.
It's every day that has you in it.
en.editorNote: For when you want to confess without going full cheese — swap 'I love you' for 'every day with you shines.' Understated, devastating
variations: Short: it was never the weather shining — it was the way you stood there
Advanced: what I love isn't any one day, it's every day with you in it

items.sourceNote: 《今生是第一次》改寫：人心不是搶來的，是它自己走過來的

zh-tw.content:
公車靠站，你上車刷卡，
抬頭發現最後一排靠窗，
還留著一個空位。

沒有人替你留，
也沒有人跟你搶，
它就是在那裡，
剛好在你抬頭的那一秒。

心也是這樣走過來的。

所以別追、別逼、別急著證明，
你越用力，它越往後退。

把自己坐直了，
該來的自然會停在你旁邊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個追得很累、一直想證明自己值得被愛的朋友——心是走過來的，不是搶來的，先別那麼用力
variations: 短版：心不是搶來的，是它某天自己走過來的
進階：你越用力它越想躲，把自己準備好就好

en.content:
A heart
isn't something you grab, or force.

It just, one day,
slowly walks over on its own.

So stop rushing to prove anything,
and stop chasing anyone —
the harder you push, the more it wants to hide.

Just get yourself ready.
Whatever's meant to come
will arrive at some unguarded moment,
standing right in front of you.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's exhausted from chasing, always trying to prove they're worth loving — a heart walks over, you can't grab it; ease off the throttle
variations: Short: a heart isn't grabbed — one day it just walks over on its own
Advanced: the harder you push, the more it hides; just get yourself ready

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句改寫：時間會帶走也會留下，喜歡就趁現在說

zh-tw.content:
去年跨年，你們在人擠人的路口拍了一張合照，
你嫌自己閉眼，順手就刪了。

今年跨年，同一個路口，
你翻遍整本相簿，
找不到任何一張有他的畫面。

想說的話就趁現在說，
別等到日子過完了，
才發現只剩滿手的「早知道」。

時間最後留給我們的，
是那些好好愛過某個人的日子，
還有那天沒捨得刪的照片。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在年末回顧、或想對某個重要的人開口卻一直拖的時候——時間不等人，喜歡就趁現在說
variations: 短版：喜歡一個人就趁現在說，別等到滿手都是早知道
進階：時間留給我們最好的禮物，是好好愛過某人的記憶

en.content:
Time keeps moving forward,
so it always brings farewells,

and always leaves a little regret behind.
If you like someone,
say it now —

don't wait until the days are spent
to find your hands full of 'I should have.'
The gift time finally leaves us

isn't how fair it was.
It's the memories
of having truly loved someone.
en.editorNote: Good for a year-end reflection, or for when you keep putting off saying something to someone who matters — time doesn't wait; if you like them, say it now
variations: Short: if you like someone, say it now — before your hands fill with 'I should have'
Advanced: time's best gift is the memory of having truly loved someone

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》台詞改寫：你以為忘記了愛情，但真要去愛時，你的心會記得

zh-tw.content:
你以為自己早就把那段感情忘光了。

名字想不太起來，
臉也模糊了，
連當初為什麼那麼喜歡，都說不清楚。

可是哪天，
你又遇到一個讓你心動的人，
要重新學著去愛的時候——

你會發現，
腦袋忘了，
但心還記得怎麼做。

原來愛過的人不會真的消失，
他們只是變成了你愛人的方式。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直說「我早就放下了」但其實還卡著的朋友——忘記是腦袋的事，記得是心的事，你沒有白愛一場
variations: 短版：你以為忘了愛情，但真要去愛時，你的心會替你記得
進階：愛過的人不會消失，他們變成了你愛人的方式

en.content:
You thought you'd forgotten that whole relationship.

The name's gone fuzzy,
the face has blurred,
you can't even explain why you fell so hard back then.

But someday,
when someone new makes your heart skip,
and you have to learn how to love all over again —

you'll find that
your head forgot,
but your heart still remembers how.

Turns out the people you loved never really vanish.
They just become the way you love.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps insisting 'I'm so over it' but clearly isn't — forgetting is the head's job; remembering is the heart's. None of it was wasted
variations: Short: you think you forgot love, but when it's time to love again, your heart remembers for you
Advanced: the people you loved don't disappear — they become the way you love

items.sourceNote: 《背著善宰跑》台詞改寫：就算腦袋忘了你，我的心也會記得，再想盡辦法重新想起來

zh-tw.content:
我不怕老，不怕時間久，
我只怕有一天會把你忘了。

但就算真的有那麼一天——
就算我的腦袋什麼都記不得，
連你的名字都叫不出來，

我的心也會記得。

它會莫名其妙地，
在看到你的時候跳得比較快，
在你轉身的時候捨不得，
然後我就會想盡辦法，
把你一點一點重新想起來。

因為有些人，
是用心記的，不是用腦。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在很深的告白，或寫進紀念日卡片——不是甜言蜜語，是「就算忘了全世界也會記得你」那種重量
variations: 短版：就算腦袋忘了你，我的心也會記得，再想盡辦法把你重新想起來
進階：有些人是用心記的，不是用腦——所以我永遠不會真的失去你

en.content:
I'm not afraid of getting old, or of time passing.
I'm only afraid that one day I'll forget you.

But even if that day comes —
even if my head can't hold a single thing,
even if I can't say your name —

my heart will remember.

It'll beat a little faster for no reason
when it sees you,
ache a little when you turn away,
and then I'll find a way
to piece you back together, memory by memory.

Because some people
you remember with your heart,
not your head.
en.editorNote: For a deep confession, or an anniversary card — not sweet nothings, but the heavy kind: 'even if I forget the whole world, I'll remember you'
variations: Short: even if my head forgets you, my heart will remember and find a way to bring you back
Advanced: some people you remember with your heart, not your head — so I'll never really lose you

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句改寫：光是維持普通生活就耗盡全力，承認自己只想當個平凡人並不丟臉

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大很簡單，
後來才發現——
光是把普通的日子過好，
就已經用掉我全部的力氣了。

準時起床、好好吃飯、
不對人發脾氣、把事情做完，
這些聽起來很基本的事，
有時候難得要命。

所以如果你也只是想
安安穩穩當個普通人，
那一點都不丟臉。

能把平凡的生活撐住，
本身就很了不起了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得自己「不夠上進、不夠成功」而焦慮的朋友——能好好把日子過下去，已經是很大的本事
variations: 短版：光是把普通的日子過好，就已經用掉我全部的力氣了
進階：想安穩當個普通人不丟臉，能撐住平凡的生活本身就很厲害

en.content:
As a kid I thought growing up would be easy.
Then I found out —
just keeping an ordinary life running
takes everything I've got.

Waking up on time, eating properly,
not snapping at people, getting things done —
these basic-sounding things
are brutally hard some days.

So if all you want
is to be a steady, ordinary person,
that is nothing to be ashamed of.

Holding a plain little life together
is already something to be proud of.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's anxious about not being 'ambitious or successful enough' — just keeping your life running is a real skill
variations: Short: just keeping an ordinary life running takes everything I've got
Advanced: wanting to be a steady, ordinary person isn't shameful — holding a plain life together is already an achievement

items.sourceNote: 《雖然是精神病但沒關係》《海岸村恰恰恰》風格改寫：人生總會淋到雨，與其撐傘不如張開手歡迎它

zh-tw.content:
人生總有幾場躲不掉的雨。

你以為帶了傘就不會濕，
結果風一斜，
還是淋了滿身。

後來我學會一件事：
與其一直想著怎麼不被淋濕，
不如乾脆把手張開，
抬頭，
好好接住那場雨。

反正都要濕了，
那就濕得痛快一點。
哭也行，怕也行，
只要你還願意往前走，
雨總會停的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在硬撐、假裝沒事的人——不用一直防著壞事發生，允許自己淋一場雨，也是一種勇敢
variations: 短版：反正都要濕了，那就把手張開，好好接住那場雨
進階：與其想著怎麼不被淋濕，不如抬頭歡迎它——雨總會停的

en.content:
Life always has a few storms you can't dodge.

You think the umbrella will keep you dry,
but the wind tilts,
and you end up soaked anyway.

Here's what I finally learned:
instead of obsessing over staying dry,
just open your hands,
look up,
and let the rain land.

You're getting wet either way,
so get wet on your own terms.
Cry if you need to, be scared if you are —
as long as you're still willing to keep walking,
the rain always stops eventually.
en.editorNote: Send to someone white-knuckling through a hard time and pretending it's fine — you don't have to brace against everything; letting yourself get rained on is its own kind of brave
variations: Short: you're getting wet anyway — so open your hands and let the rain land
Advanced: instead of fighting to stay dry, look up and welcome it — the rain always stops

items.sourceNote: 《今生是第一次》台詞改寫：話也要進到一個人的心裡，才能活下去

zh-tw.content:
你說過的那些話，
不會因為出了口，
就自動長出重量。

話跟人一樣，
要走進對方心裡，
才算真的活下來。

你講了三年的「我愛你」，
每次都趕在掛電話前
急著補上去。

如果他到現在
還會在半夜問你
「那你到底愛不愛我」，

那三年的話
到底停在哪裡？

你今天說的那句，
有走到他那邊嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在感情卡關、覺得「我明明說了很多」卻不被理解的時候——說出口只是第一步，被聽進去才算數
variations: 短版：話跟人一樣，要進到對方心裡才能真正活下來
進階：「我愛你」不是說了就算數，是對方接住了，它才開始有重量

en.content:
The things you've said
don't automatically mean something just because you said them.

Words are like people —
they only truly live
once they make it into someone's heart.

So 'I love you'
isn't settled the moment it leaves your mouth.
It starts to carry weight
only when the other person catches it, believes it, feels safe in it.

Don't rush to prove how sincere you are.
Ask them first —
the words I said,
did they ever make it into your heart?
en.editorNote: For when a relationship is stuck and you feel like 'I've said so much' but aren't understood — saying it is only step one; being truly heard is what counts
variations: Short: words are like people — they only truly live once they reach someone's heart
Advanced: 'I love you' isn't settled when you say it; it gains weight only when they catch it

items.sourceNote: 台劇《影后》金句改編，原台詞核心：要先成為人物才有資格掉眼淚，重寫為情緒主軸

zh-tw.content:
《影后》最戳人的一句話：

等你變成個咖，你的眼淚才有人看。

難聽，但是真的。

沒人關心無名小卒哭什麼，
他們只會問你「怎麼了」當作客套，
然後轉頭就忘。

所以別急著哭給誰看，
先把自己活成一個，
值得別人停下腳步的人。

到那時候，連你的沉默都有重量。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼給正在咬牙撐過低潮、覺得沒人看見自己努力的朋友——不是雞湯，是現實裡的提醒
variations: 短版：先成為被看見的人，眼淚才不會白流
溫柔版：現在沒人懂你的眼淚，不代表它不值錢，只是你還沒走到那個位置

en.content:
The line from this drama that hits hardest:

Your tears only matter once you've become somebody.

Harsh. But true.

Nobody cares why a nobody is crying.
They'll ask 'what's wrong' out of politeness,
then forget it the moment they turn away.

So don't rush to cry for an audience.
First become someone
worth stopping for.

By then, even your silence will carry weight.
en.editorNote: For the friend grinding through a low point who feels invisible — not a pep talk, a real-world reminder
variations: Short: become someone who gets seen first, and your tears won't fall for nothing
Gentle: no one understands your tears right now — that doesn't make them worthless, you just haven't arrived yet

items.sourceNote: 台劇《影后》金句改編，原台詞核心：手機不能沒電卻沒問過自己有沒有電，重寫為自我照顧主軸

zh-tw.content:
《影后》裡有句話，我看完愣了很久：

手機快沒電就緊張得要命，
到處找充電線、搶插座，
但我好像從來沒問過自己——

你今天還剩幾趴？

我們把所有電量
都拿去回別人的訊息、撐別人的期待，
卻忘了自己也會耗盡。

從今天起，
至少留一格電給自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在限時動態、或轉給那個把所有人都照顧好、只剩自己沒人顧的朋友
variations: 短版：你會幫手機充電，那今天有幫自己充過嗎？
提醒版：別等到自己完全沒電才想到要休息，低電量就該進省電模式了

en.content:
A line from this drama that stopped me cold:

When my phone hits low battery I panic,
hunting for a cable, fighting for an outlet.
But I don't think I've ever asked myself —

how much battery do you have left today?

We pour all our charge
into answering everyone, holding up everyone's expectations,
and forget that we run out too.

From now on,
keep at least one bar for yourself.
en.editorNote: Good for a story post, or to send to the friend who takes care of everyone and has no one taking care of them
variations: Short: you charge your phone — did you charge yourself today?
Reminder: don't wait until you hit zero to rest; low battery already means switch to power-saving mode

items.sourceNote: 台劇《影后》金句改編，原台詞核心：談戀愛是瘋子笨蛋才談戀愛，重寫為自嘲式愛情語錄

zh-tw.content:
《影后》有句話講得超狠：

會談戀愛的都是瘋子，
笨蛋才會去談戀愛。

聽起來像在罵人，
仔細想想又無法反駁——

明知道可能會受傷，還是跳下去；
明知道對方有缺點，還是覺得他可愛；
明知道很麻煩，還是想每天見到他。

所以是的，
我承認我又瘋又笨，
而且還挺甘願的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合熱戀期的人自嘲，或在情人節、交往紀念日轉給另一半當作土味告白
variations: 土味版：別人說談戀愛的是笨蛋，那我願意為你笨一輩子
短版：明知是坑還往下跳，這就是愛情，傻得很值得

en.content:
There's a brutal line in this drama:

Only crazy people fall in love.
Only fools actually do it.

Sounds like an insult,
but think about it and you can't argue —

you know you might get hurt, and you jump anyway.
you know their flaws, and find them cute anyway.
you know it's a hassle, and want to see them every day anyway.

So yeah,
I'll admit I'm crazy and a fool,
and honestly, pretty happy about it.
en.editorNote: Good for the honeymoon-phase couple to self-deprecate, or as a cheesy line for Valentine's or an anniversary
variations: Cheesy: they say lovers are fools — then I'll happily be a fool for you forever
Short: knowing it's a trap and diving in anyway — that's love, and it's worth every bit of dumb

items.sourceNote: 台劇《何百芮的地獄戀曲》2026續作，網紅人設主題，原創改編社群光鮮vs真實對照

zh-tw.content:
看完《何百芮的地獄戀曲》，才懂網紅人生的真相：

早上九點的限時動態：陽光、拉花、歲月靜好。
早上八點四十的現場：重拍第四十一次，咖啡涼掉沒人喝。

貼文寫「隨手記錄」，那個構圖她想了一小時。
留言寫「真羨慕你」，你看到的是她挑剩下的那一格。

濾鏡開到最大也不會讓人發光，
你要連沒修圖的那一天，
也願意好好過完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼給一直拿自己跟網路上完美生活比較、越滑越焦慮的朋友——別人的精選輯，不是你的全集
variations: 短版：你看到的是別人的限時動態，不是別人的全天
提醒版：濾鏡可以調，日子要自己過，鏡頭外那個你才是主角

en.content:
After watching this influencer drama,
you finally get the truth behind the highlight reel:

In the story post = serene mornings, latte art and sunlight
After the camera's off = forty retakes for one photo

Caption says 'just a casual snap' = an hour spent on composition
Comments say 'so jealous of your life' = you only see the side she chose to show

Life doesn't glow because the filter's cranked all the way up.
It glows when you're willing to live the unedited side
just as fully.
en.editorNote: For the friend who keeps comparing themselves to perfect online lives and spirals the more they scroll — someone's highlight reel is not your full footage
variations: Short: you're seeing their story, not their whole day
Reminder: filters are adjustable, but the days are yours to live — the you off-camera is the real lead

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《莎拉的真偽人生》2026金句，原台詞核心：人們往往認為自己相信的就是真相，重寫為認知主題

zh-tw.content:
《莎拉的真偽人生》最讓我背脊發涼的一句：

人常常把「自己相信的」，
當成「事情的真相」。

同一頓晚餐，
你記得他先摔了筷子，
他記得你先冷笑一聲，
兩個人為這件事吵了三年，
爭的其實是各自腦裡剪好的那部片。

真正成熟的人，
會在開口前先停半秒：

我現在要講的，是真的發生過，
還是我很希望它是那樣？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在跟人爭執到鬼打牆時自我提醒，或轉給總是堅信自己一定對的朋友
variations: 短版：你相信的不一定是真的，只是你比較想要它是真的
犀利版：很多爭吵不是真相之爭，是兩個版本的執念在打架

en.content:
The line from this drama that gave me chills:

People often mistake
what they believe for what's true.

That's why two people
can argue over the same event forever —
they're not fighting about the facts,
but about the versions already written in their heads.

A truly mature person
asks one question before speaking:

is what I'm saying the truth,
or do I just want it to be true?
en.editorNote: A self-check for when an argument is going in circles, or send to the friend who's always certain they're right
variations: Short: what you believe isn't necessarily true — you just want it to be
Sharp: most arguments aren't about the truth; they're two versions of stubbornness colliding

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句「你的幸福，為什麼要問別人？」核心改寫為自我認同主題

zh-tw.content:
有一句韓劇台詞，我反覆看了三次：

你的快樂，
為什麼要等別人點頭？

你穿得開心，先問朋友好不好看；
你想換工作，先問家人值不值得；
你喜歡一個人，先問大家配不配。

問到最後，
那個本來最清楚自己要什麼的人，
變成全場最猶豫的那一個。

別人的意見可以聽，
但決定權，從頭到尾都該握在你手裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給那種凡事都要先問別人意見、活得很累的朋友，提醒他人生是自己的
variations: 短版：你的人生不需要過半數同意才能開始
溫柔版：參考別人沒關係，但最後簽名的那一格，要留給自己

en.content:
One drama line I rewatched three times:

Why does your happiness
need someone else's permission?

You love your outfit — but first you ask if friends approve.
You want a new job — but first you ask if family thinks it's worth it.
You like someone — but first you ask if everyone thinks you match.

Ask long enough,
and the person who once knew exactly what they wanted
becomes the most hesitant one in the room.

Listen to opinions if you like.
But the final call was always yours to make.
en.editorNote: For the friend who runs every choice past a committee and is exhausted by it — a reminder that it's their life
variations: Short: your life doesn't need a majority vote to begin
Gentle: take all the advice you want, but leave the signature line for yourself

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《今生也請多指教》「人到死都不會懂事，大家都是裝出來的」改寫為成長主題

zh-tw.content:
看《今生也請多指教》學到最真實的一課：

沒有人是真的「長大成熟」了，
大家只是越來越會「裝」而已。

表面上沉穩淡定的大人，
心裡可能跟二十歲時一樣慌；
看起來什麼都懂的前輩，
也是邊做邊怕、邊怕邊撐過來的。

所以別再覺得只有你還沒準備好——
全世界都是邊裝鎮定，
邊偷偷查「這個到底該怎麼辦」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給覺得自己「不夠成熟」而焦慮的朋友，或在冒牌者症候群發作時自我安慰
variations: 短版：沒人真的長大，只是越來越會裝沒事
幽默版：所謂大人，就是把『我也不知道』講得很有自信的人

en.content:
The most honest lesson I took from this drama:

Nobody actually "grows up" and figures it out —
we just get better at pretending we have.

The calm, composed adult
may be just as panicked inside as they were at twenty.
The senior who seems to know everything
is also doing it scared, holding on by the fingernails.

So stop thinking you're the only one who isn't ready.
The whole world is faking the calm
while secretly googling "what do I even do here."
en.editorNote: For the friend anxious about not being 'mature enough,' or a self-soothe for an impostor-syndrome flare-up
variations: Short: nobody really grows up; we just get better at acting fine
Funny: an adult is just someone who says 'I have no idea' with great confidence

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《壞媽媽》「只要活著，自然就能這樣活下去」核心改寫為低潮陪伴主題

zh-tw.content:
《壞媽媽》裡有一句，我難過的時候會想起：

只要還活著，
日子自然就會這樣一天一天過下去。

你不需要一次想清楚整個人生，
不需要今天就把所有問題解決。
你只要負責——
吃一頓飯、睡一場覺、撐過這一天。

剩下的，時間會慢慢幫你接住。
你以為過不去的，
後來都只是回頭看的一段路而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給正在低潮、覺得撐不下去的人，或在自己最累的夜晚存起來看
variations: 短版：別急著想通一輩子，先過好今天這一天就好
溫柔版：你現在覺得跨不過的坎，未來都只是一句『原來那時候啊』

en.content:
A line from this drama I reach for on hard days:

As long as you're still alive,
the days will keep going, one at a time.

You don't have to figure out your whole life at once.
You don't have to solve every problem today.
Your only job is this —
eat a meal, get some sleep, make it through this one day.

The rest, time will quietly catch for you.
What feels impossible to get past
turns out, later, to be just a stretch of road you already walked.
en.editorNote: For someone in a low place who feels they can't hold on, or to save for your own most tired nights
variations: Short: don't rush to make sense of a lifetime — just get through today
Gentle: the wall you can't climb now becomes, someday, just an 'oh, back then'

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《低谷醫生》生活哲理金句改寫為休息正當性主題

zh-tw.content:
《低谷醫生》最打中我的一句：

停下來喘一口氣，
並不代表你輸了，
只代表你已經跑得夠久。

他把筆電闔上，
沒有存檔，也沒有回那封還亮著的信。

他倒了一杯溫開水，
坐到窗邊，
看樓下的機車一台一台停好。

十五分鐘，
沒做任何有生產力的事。

然後他站起來，
把明天的事排進行事曆。

機器都要關機散熱，
你憑什麼二十四小時運轉還不出錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給那種一停下來就有罪惡感的工作狂朋友，或在你自己撐到極限的時候提醒自己
variations: 短版：休息不是放棄，是讓你跑得更遠的必要保養
犀利版：連手機都要充電，你憑什麼要求自己永遠滿電

en.content:
The line from this drama that hit hardest:

Stopping to rest
doesn't mean you lost —
it means you ran long enough to deserve a breath.

We're raised to "try harder,"
but nobody teaches us how to actually stop.
So the moment we slow down, guilt kicks in,
as if not being busy is wasting our life.

But even machines need to power down and cool off.
Why would you expect to run 24/7 without a single fault?
Resting when you're tired
isn't slacking — it's maintenance.
en.editorNote: For the workaholic friend who feels guilty the second they slow down, or a reminder for yourself when you're running on empty
variations: Short: rest isn't quitting — it's the upkeep that lets you go further
Sharp: even your phone needs charging; why demand you stay at 100% forever

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《淚之女王》婚姻愛情金句改寫為長久關係主題

zh-tw.content:
《淚之女王》讓我重新想了一遍愛情這件事：

剛在一起時，
我們愛的是對方最閃亮的那一面。
相處久了才發現，
真正的感情，
是連對方最狼狽、最不可愛的時候，
你都還願意留在原地。

心動誰都會，
難的是把「我喜歡你」
慢慢熬成「我們一起把日子過下去」。

愛上很容易，
陪到最後才是真的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給結婚紀念日或交往多年的另一半，也適合存起來提醒自己長久關係的本質
variations: 短版：愛上你只要一秒，陪你過日子才是一輩子的功課
甜版：我不只想要你最好的樣子，連你最累那天，我也想在旁邊

en.content:
This drama made me rethink what love actually is:

At the start,
we fall for someone's brightest, shiniest side.
It's only after a long time together
that you learn —
real love is staying right where you are
even on their messiest, least lovable days.

Anyone can feel a spark.
The hard part is slowly turning "I like you"
into "let's get through the days together."

Falling in love is easy.
Staying to the end is the real thing.
en.editorNote: For an anniversary message to a long-term partner, or to save as a reminder of what lasting love really is
variations: Short: falling for you takes a second; staying with you is a lifetime's work
Sweet: I don't just want you at your best — on your most exhausted day, I want to be there too

items.sourceNote: 改寫自《海岸村恰恰恰》「世界上除了金錢與成就還有很多值得追求」的人生主題金句

zh-tw.content:
《海岸村恰恰恰》有一句，我看完盯著螢幕很久：

這世界上，
除了賺錢跟出人頭地，
其實還有好多東西值得你去追。

一頓不趕時間的晚餐、
一個願意陪你發呆的人、
一個你睡飽後還記得的夢。

我們花了太多力氣，
去追那些別人說「成功」的東西，
卻常常忘了問自己：
那真的是我想要的嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給為了業績焦慮到睡不著的朋友，或在你自己快被KPI追著跑的時候，存起來提醒自己慢一點
variations: 短版：成功不只一種長相，別把別人的標準活成自己的人生
犀利版：你拼命追的那個目標，到底是你的願望，還是別人塞給你的

en.content:
A line from this seaside drama that made me stare at the screen for a while:

In this world,
beyond making money and getting ahead,
there's actually so much else worth chasing.

A dinner you don't have to rush.
Someone willing to sit and do nothing beside you.
A dream you still remember after a full night's sleep.

We pour so much energy
into the things other people call "success,"
and forget to ask ourselves:
is that even what I wanted?
en.editorNote: For the friend losing sleep over sales targets, or save it for yourself when the KPIs are chasing you faster than you can run
variations: Short: success doesn't have just one shape — don't live someone else's standard as your life
Sharp: that goal you're sprinting toward — is it your wish, or one someone handed you?

items.sourceNote: 改寫自《因為這是我的第一次人生》「話也要進到人心裡才能活下去」的台詞主題
tags: 因為這是我的第一次人生

zh-tw.content:
《因為這是我的第一次人生》最戳我的一句：

話，
也要進到一個人心裡，
才能真的活下來。

你說過多少漂亮的道理，
不重要。
重要的是有沒有一句，
被某個人收進心底，
在他難過的夜裡偷偷亮起來。

我們都是第一次活，
第一次當大人、第一次愛人、第一次失去，
笨拙一點沒關係，
反正大家都在邊走邊學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給正在經歷人生第一次、手足無措的朋友，提醒對方笨拙也是被允許的
variations: 短版：人生每件事都是第一次，做不好很正常，別急著怪自己
溫柔版：你不是失敗，你只是第一次，誰的第一次不狼狽

en.content:
The line from this drama that got me:

Words, too,
have to get inside a person's heart
before they can truly live on.

How many clever truths you've said
doesn't matter.
What matters is whether one of them
got tucked into someone's heart,
quietly lighting up on their hardest nights.

We're all living for the first time —
first time being an adult, first time loving, first time losing.
It's okay to be a little clumsy.
Everyone's learning as they go.
en.editorNote: For the friend stumbling through a first-time-anything in life — a reminder that being clumsy is allowed
variations: Short: everything in life is a first time; messing up is normal, don't rush to blame yourself
Gentle: you didn't fail — you're just new at this, and nobody's first time is graceful

items.sourceNote: 改寫自2026治癒系韓劇「你的幸福為什麼要問別人」療癒主題金句

zh-tw.content:
2026年治癒系韓劇裡，這句我截圖存起來了：

你的幸福，
為什麼要問別人？

別人說你過得好，你才安心；
別人覺得你選錯，你就動搖。
可是日子是你在過，
冷暖也只有你自己知道。

不用等誰來蓋章認證，
你覺得舒服、睡得安穩、笑得出來，
那就是好好活著了。

幸福不是考試，
沒有標準答案，也沒有人能幫你打分數。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給太在意別人眼光、總是活給別人看的朋友，也適合在你自己又開始討好世界的時候提醒自己
variations: 短版：你的人生不用別人核准，過得舒服比過得好看更重要
犀利版：那些評論你的人，又不會替你過這一生

en.content:
From the healing K-dramas of 2026, this one I screenshotted and kept:

Your happiness —
why are you asking other people about it?

You relax only when others say you're doing fine;
you waver the moment they think you chose wrong.
But you're the one living this life,
and only you know what it actually feels like.

You don't need anyone to stamp their approval.
If you feel at ease, sleep soundly, and can still laugh —
that already counts as living well.

Happiness isn't an exam.
There's no correct answer, and no one to grade you.
en.editorNote: For the friend who lives for everyone's approval, or for yourself the next time you catch yourself trying to please the whole world
variations: Short: your life doesn't need anyone's sign-off — feeling at ease beats looking impressive
Sharp: the people judging your life aren't the ones who have to live it

items.sourceNote: 改寫自《今生也請多指教》「人到死都不會懂事，大家都是裝出來的」人生主題台詞

zh-tw.content:
《今生也請多指教》有一句，我笑完又有點想哭：

人，
大概到死都不會真的「懂事」，
大家只是裝得比較像而已。

你以為長大就會有答案，
結果三十歲、四十歲，
還是會在深夜懷疑人生、
還是會為一句話玻璃心一整天。

所謂大人，
不過是學會了把慌張藏進西裝裡，
然後笑著說「我沒事」。

所以別再苛責自己不夠成熟了，
你已經很努力在裝大人了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給那種一直覺得自己「不夠成熟、活得很失敗」的朋友，幽默又溫暖地拍拍對方
variations: 短版：沒有人真的長大，我們都只是越裝越熟練
self-deprecating版：我不是不成熟，我只是還沒練好那個假裝的表情

en.content:
A line from this drama made me laugh, then almost cry:

People
probably never truly "grow up" before they die —
everyone's just gotten better at faking it.

You think being an adult comes with answers,
but at thirty, at forty,
you still doubt your whole life at 2 a.m.,
still get wrecked all day by one offhand comment.

A grown-up
is just someone who learned to tuck the panic inside a blazer
and say, with a smile, "I'm fine."

So stop scolding yourself for not being mature enough.
You're already trying so hard to play the adult.
en.editorNote: For the friend who keeps feeling 'not mature enough, failing at life' — a warm, funny pat on the shoulder
variations: Short: nobody actually grows up; we just get more practiced at pretending
Self-deprecating: I'm not immature — I just haven't perfected the pretending face yet

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句整理，情緒像感冒的比喻，改寫成給低潮朋友的溫柔語錄

zh-tw.content:
有一句台詞我截圖存了好久：

「情緒生病，其實跟感冒一樣正常。」

沒有人會因為感冒罵自己不夠堅強，
可是心一累，我們就急著逼自己好起來。

你現在覺得被關在一片黑裡，看不到出口，
這很正常，不是你的錯。
早晨的光遲早會照進來，
只是它不趕時間——

那你也別趕。
給自己多一點時間，慢慢好就好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在硬撐、覺得自己「怎麼還沒好」的朋友，或存起來在自己撐不住的深夜看一眼
variations: 短版：情緒感冒不用逞強，光會進來，只是它不趕時間
自我對話版：我不是不夠堅強，我只是還在康復，慢慢來沒關係

en.content:
A line I screenshotted and kept for months:

"An emotion getting sick is as normal as catching a cold."

Nobody yells at themselves for being weak when they have a cold —
but the moment our heart gets tired, we rush to force ourselves better.

Right now you feel locked in the dark with no exit in sight.
That's normal. It's not your fault.
The morning light will reach you eventually —
it's just in no hurry.

So don't rush either.
Give yourself a little more time. Getting better slowly is still getting better.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend who's white-knuckling it and feels 'why am I not okay yet' — or save it for your own 3 a.m.
variations: Short: an emotional cold doesn't need toughing out; the light will come, it's just not in a hurry
Self-talk: I'm not weak, I'm recovering — slowly is fine

items.sourceNote: 《苦盡柑來遇見你》金句，「沒有人真正長大，但每次心痛都長大一點」概念改寫

zh-tw.content:
這部劇有句話，看到當下鼻子就酸了：

「我們其實沒有一個人真的長大。
只是每一次心痛，都讓我們悄悄長大了一點點。」

它沒有假裝人生會變簡單，
也沒有給你什麼標準答案。
它只是承認——
是啊，這真的很難，
可是我們還是一天一天走過來了。

有時候你以為自己原地踏步，
其實你早就走了好遠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給覺得自己「什麼都沒進步」的人；或年末回顧、生日、跨年時當作給自己的一句話
variations: 短版：沒有人一次長大，我們都是被心痛一點一點磨大的
鼓勵版：你以為在原地，其實你已經走了好遠，只是自己沒發現

en.content:
This drama had a line that stung the second I heard it:

"None of us has really grown up.
We just grew a little each time our heart ached."

It doesn't pretend life gets easier.
It doesn't hand you a tidy answer.
It just admits it —
yeah, this is genuinely hard,
and somehow we keep making it through, day by day.

Sometimes you think you're standing still.
You've actually come so much further than you realize.
en.editorNote: For someone who feels they've 'made zero progress' — or as a note to yourself on a birthday, New Year, or year-end look-back
variations: Short: nobody grows up all at once; we get worn a little bigger by every heartache
Encouraging: you think you're stuck in place — you've actually come so far, you just didn't notice

items.sourceNote: 《戀愛實用指南》2026金句，現代人不等命運、自己選對象的概念改寫成幽默戀愛觀

zh-tw.content:
這部劇一句話戳破所有偶像劇濾鏡：

「美好的愛情，總說要從一場命中註定的相遇開始。
但現在的單身男女，才不會傻站著等命運送愛情來。
他們自己挑對象、自己決定什麼時候開始、什麼時候結束。」

看完只想說：
對，命運如果那麼可靠，
交友軟體早就倒了。

愛情不是從一個人先淪陷才開始的——
所以，去見那場相親吧，說不定挺好玩。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給還在等「對的時間、對的人」的單身朋友，鼓勵他主動一點；或當作放下偶像劇幻想的清醒宣言
variations: 短版：別等命運了，命運要真可靠，交友軟體早倒了
行動版：對的人不會自己走過來，主動不丟臉，站著等才浪費

en.content:
One line from this drama shatters every rom-com filter:

"A beautiful love story is supposed to begin with a fated, dramatic encounter.
But singles today don't stand around waiting for fate to deliver love.
They pick their own person, decide when it starts, and when it ends."

Honestly? Same.
If fate were that reliable,
dating apps would've gone bankrupt years ago.

Love doesn't begin only when one person falls first —
so go to the blind date. It might actually be fun.
en.editorNote: For the single friend still waiting for 'the right time, the right person' — a nudge to be proactive, or a sober goodbye to rom-com fantasies
variations: Short: stop waiting on fate — if fate delivered, dating apps would've folded by now
Action version: the right person doesn't walk over on their own; being proactive isn't embarrassing, standing still is the waste

items.sourceNote: 海岸村恰恰恰式「金錢成就以外還有很多值得追求」概念，改寫成台劇風格的生活觀語錄

zh-tw.content:
劇裡那個看起來一無所有的人，說了一句我到現在都記得：

「這世界上啊，除了錢跟成就，
還有很多值得你追的東西。
幸福、把自己活成想要的樣子、
睡得著、笑得出來，
還有——有人真的懂你。」

我們花好多年追那張成績單，
卻忘了問自己一句：
那我快樂嗎？

有時候贏了全世界，
卻在深夜輸給一個人的安靜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給拼過頭、忘記為什麼而拼的朋友；或貼在自己書桌前，提醒自己別把KPI當成人生
variations: 短版：贏了全世界，別在深夜輸給自己的安靜
提醒版：成績單不會抱你，記得留點力氣給讓你笑得出來的事

en.content:
The character who looked like he had nothing said a line I still remember:

"In this world, besides money and achievements,
there's so much worth chasing.
Happiness. Becoming the version of yourself you actually wanted.
Sleeping through the night. Being able to laugh.
And — someone who genuinely gets you."

We spend years chasing the report card
and forget to ask ourselves one thing:
am I even happy?

Sometimes you win the whole world
and still lose, quietly, at 2 a.m.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's grinding so hard they forgot why — or pin it above your desk as a reminder your KPIs aren't your life
variations: Short: win the whole world, but don't lose to your own silence at 2 a.m.
Reminder: a report card won't hug you — save some energy for the things that make you laugh

items.sourceNote: 《此時此刻》躲避球比喻人生概念，改寫成台劇風格的關係與人生體悟語錄

zh-tw.content:
劇裡有個角色打躲避球打到一半，突然說：

「其實談感情跟躲避球很像。
球會從你看不到的角度飛過來，
你要夠會閃、夠會接，
才有辦法撐到最後一個站在場上。

但你有沒有想過——
一直閃、一直躲的人，
是不會有人敢傳球給他的。」

我愣了很久。
原來我一直以為自己很會保護自己，
其實只是沒有人敢靠近而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總說「我單身是因為我喜歡自由」的朋友；或在自己又下意識推開一個人之後，拿出來看一次
variations: 短版：一直閃球的人不會受傷，但也不會有人敢傳球給他
溫柔版：保護自己跟關上心門，其實只差一個願不願意接球

en.content:
A character in this drama paused mid-dodgeball game and said:

"Relationships are a lot like dodgeball.
The ball comes flying from the angle you can't see,
and you have to dodge well, catch well,
just to be the last one standing on the court.

But have you ever thought about it —
the person who only ever dodges,
nobody dares to throw them the ball."

I sat with that for a long time.
I thought I was just good at protecting myself.
Turns out no one ever dared come close.
en.editorNote: For the friend who insists 'I'm single because I love my freedom' — or pull it up the next time you instinctively push someone away
variations: Short: the one who only dodges never gets hurt — but no one ever throws them the ball either
Gentle version: protecting yourself and locking the door are one decision apart — whether you'll catch the ball

items.sourceNote: 《影后》「我從來沒問過自己還有沒有電」自省概念，改寫成現代人耗竭主題的台劇語錄

zh-tw.content:
劇裡那個永遠光鮮亮麗的女主角，在後台卸妝時說了一句：

「我一直在充別人的電，
卻從來沒問過自己——
我還有沒有電。」

看到這裡我把螢幕暫停。

我們都太會照顧別人了：
朋友難過秒回訊息，
同事求助立刻幫忙，
家人一通電話就放下手邊的事。

可是自己累到快關機的時候，
卻連一句「我需要休息」都說不出口。

記得，先充飽自己，
才有電分給你愛的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是照顧全世界、卻忘了自己的朋友；或設成手機桌布，提醒自己也是需要充電的人
variations: 短版：先充飽自己，才有電分給你愛的人
提醒版：你不是充電寶，允許自己有一天只想關機

en.content:
The always-glamorous lead, taking off her makeup backstage, said:

"I've spent my whole life charging everyone else's battery,
and never once asked myself —
do I have any charge left?"

I hit pause right there.

We're all so good at taking care of people:
reply the second a friend is sad,
drop everything when a coworker needs help,
one phone call from family and we put our life on hold.

But when we're the ones running to zero,
we can't even say 'I need to rest.'

Remember — charge yourself first.
Only then do you have anything left to give the people you love.
en.editorNote: For the friend who takes care of the whole world and forgets themselves — or set it as your lock screen, a reminder you need charging too
variations: Short: charge yourself first — then you'll have something left for the people you love
Reminder: you're not a power bank; you're allowed to have a day where you just want to power off

items.sourceNote: 《此時此刻》「愛也有死角，藏著錯過的風景」概念，改寫成台劇風格的愛情體悟語錄

zh-tw.content:
劇裡有句台詞，我看完當晚翻來覆去睡不著：

「眼睛看東西會有死角，
愛一個人也會。

那些你以為錯過的、沒發生的、
來不及說出口的，
其實沒有真的消失，
只是躲在你看不到的那個角落，
變成一片你這輩子都不會忘記的風景。」

有些人不是不夠好，
只是剛好站在你看不見的地方。

而你花了很多年才明白——
有些風景，錯過了才看得最清楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個心裡還放著一個名字的人；或在深夜想起某個人的時候，安靜地看一次就好
variations: 短版：有些風景，錯過了才看得最清楚
釋懷版：他不是不夠好，只是剛好站在你看不見的角度

en.content:
A line from this drama kept me tossing and turning that night:

"Your eyes have a blind spot when they look at things.
So does loving someone.

The ones you think you missed, that never happened,
the words you never got to say —
they didn't actually disappear.
They're just hiding in the corner you can't see,
turned into a view you'll never forget your whole life."

Some people weren't not good enough.
They just happened to stand where you couldn't see.

And it took you years to understand —
some views only come into focus after you've missed them.
en.editorNote: For the one still holding a name in their heart — or when someone crosses your mind late at night, just read it once, quietly
variations: Short: some views only come into focus after you've already missed them
Letting-go version: he wasn't not good enough — he just stood in the angle you couldn't see

items.sourceNote: 《此時此刻》「一段關係要彼此努力、維持相同步調」概念，改寫成台劇風格的關係經營語錄

zh-tw.content:
劇裡分手那場戲，女生沒有大吵大鬧，只是把外套穿好才開口：

「我們約七點，
我七點到，
你每次都八點半。

我等你的時候
會把菜單看三遍，
再假裝自己剛坐下。」

男生說：「那你怎麼不早點講。」

她笑了一下：

「我講了兩年。
你每次都說下次改。
今天這頓，我請。」

最累的從來不在愛，
累的是一路上
都在等一個不肯加快腳步的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在感情裡總是付出比較多、卻捨不得放手的朋友；提醒他愛不是一個人的馬拉松
variations: 短版：最累的不是愛，是一直等一個不肯回頭的人
清醒版：只有你一個人在努力的，不叫愛情，叫獨角戲

en.content:
In the breakup scene, the woman didn't scream or cry. She just said quietly:

"For a relationship to last,
it can't be one person sprinting ahead
while the other chases from behind.

It's two people willing to walk at the same pace.
You speed up, you wait for me.
I slow down, you remind me.
That's what 'together' means.

If I'm the only one trying,
that's not love.
That's a one-woman show."

The most exhausting part was never the loving.
It was waiting for someone who wouldn't turn around.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always gives more in love but can't bear to let go — a reminder that love isn't a solo marathon
variations: Short: the exhausting part was never the love — it was waiting for someone who wouldn't turn around
Clear-eyed version: if you're the only one trying, it's not a relationship — it's a one-person show

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 你把那張撐了三年的名片撕掉那天，手在抖，心卻鬆了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合安慰剛結束一段消耗關係的朋友
variations: 這不是認輸，是你決定不再委屈自己。
你沒有失去什麼，你是把自己找回來了。

en.content: You didn't lose to anyone. You just finally decided to be kind to yourself.
en.editorNote: For comforting a friend who just left a draining relationship
variations: This isn't giving up. It's choosing to stop settling.
You didn't lose anything. You got yourself back.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 別人覺得你在繞遠路，其實你只是走一條沒人陪的路。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合鼓勵正在為目標努力、卻被質疑的人
variations: 你不是走得慢，你只是走得比較孤單。
看起來像迷路，其實你比誰都清楚要去哪。

en.content: They think you're taking the long way. You're just walking a road no one wanted to walk with you.
en.editorNote: To encourage someone chasing a goal while being doubted
variations: You're not slow. You're just walking it alone.
It looks like you're lost, but you know exactly where you're headed.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 摔門聲過後十分鐘，客廳的燈還亮著，桌上多了一碗切好的水果。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫家庭和解、或親子關係的溫暖時刻
variations: 我們會吵，但沒有人真的想走。
家的意思，就是氣歸氣，飯還是一起吃。

en.content: Home isn't a place where no one fights. It's the place everyone still stays after the fight.
en.editorNote: For warm family-reconciliation or parent-child moments
variations: We argue, but nobody actually wants to leave.
Home means we're still mad, and we still eat dinner together.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 2026療癒系戲劇金句主題，被遺忘與被愛的核心情感，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
被忘記其實不可怕。
真正可怕的是——你到最後都不知道，自己曾經被人這麼認真地愛過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫失憶、離別或親人漸行漸遠的橋段，也適合安慰覺得自己不重要的朋友
variations: 就算你忘了全世界，我也會記得你被愛的樣子。
怕的不是遺忘，是連被愛過都不曾察覺。

en.content:
Being forgotten isn't the scary part.
What's really scary is never realizing you were loved this deeply — all the way to the end.
en.editorNote: For scenes about memory loss, goodbyes, or drifting family; also to comfort a friend who feels invisible
variations: Forget the whole world if you must — I'll still remember how loved you were.
The fear isn't forgetting. It's never noticing you were loved at all.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 《此時此刻》做自己主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你不用勉強自己去當一個快樂的人。
你只要當你自己，快樂自然會來找你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在角色卸下面具、學會接納自己的轉折點，也適合鼓勵一直逞強的人
variations: 別急著開心，先允許自己不開心。
假裝快樂太累了，做自己反而輕鬆。

en.content:
You don't have to force yourself into being a happy person.
Just be yourself — happiness will come find you on its own.
en.editorNote: For a character's turning point when they stop performing and start accepting themselves; also for someone who's been holding it all together
variations: Don't rush to be happy. First let yourself not be.
Faking happy is exhausting. Being yourself is the easy part.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 2026古裝劇時間與執念主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
天地間的時間一直在走，
你確定要把自己困在這一刻，一輩子嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫角色放不下過去、勸人向前走的場景，古裝劇或現代劇都適用
variations: 時間沒有停，是你自己不肯往前。
你守著的不是回憶，是走不出去的自己。

en.content:
Time never stops moving through this world.
Are you really sure you want to trap yourself in this one moment — forever?
en.editorNote: For scenes where a character can't let go of the past, or when urging someone to move forward; works in period or modern settings
variations: Time didn't stop. You just refused to walk on.
It isn't the memory you're guarding — it's the version of you that can't leave.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 台劇日常與陪伴主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
回程的車上誰都沒開口，
廣播換了三首歌，
你伸手就摸到他放在中間的那隻手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫老夫老妻、多年好友的陪伴感，也適合放在安靜卻踏實的感情戲
variations: 最好的關係，是安靜下來也不尷尬。
不用一直找話題，光是有你在就夠了。

en.content:
Walking through life together
isn't about talking through every step —
it's knowing that even in the silence, someone's right beside you.
en.editorNote: For the quiet companionship of old couples or lifelong friends; fits calm, grounded relationship scenes
variations: The best relationships are the ones where silence isn't awkward.
We don't need to keep the conversation going. You just being here is enough.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 台劇人性與求而不得主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
那件衣服你在櫥窗前看了七次，
買回家之後只穿過一次。

那個沒回你訊息的人，
你翻他的頁面翻了四十幾遍。

真正勾住你的，
一直都是那個空著的格子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合描寫角色執著於得不到的人、看不清眼前所有的橋段，感情戲或內心獨白都好用
variations: 你愛的不是他，是那個「差一點就到手」的自己。
得到了才發現，原來迷人的是距離，不是他。

en.content:
People are strange —
whatever we hold, we tire of fast;

whatever we can't reach only grows more beautiful.
It's not that the person is so special.

It's that "not yet mine"
is the most convincing lie there is.
en.editorNote: For scenes where a character fixates on someone unreachable and misses what's right in front of them; works for romance beats or inner monologue
variations: You don't love him. You love the version of you that almost had him.
Once you finally had it, you realized — the magic was the distance, not the person.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 治癒系自我照顧主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
別一直盯著別人怎麼看你，
先把你自己顧好。

今天的你要過得好，
明天的你才有力氣，
來接住明天的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合低潮、自我懷疑的角色轉折點，也適合當作安慰朋友的溫柔台詞，療癒系劇最對味
variations: 先照顧好今天的自己，明天的事明天再說。
你不用讓所有人滿意，你只需要讓自己撐得下去。

en.content:
Stop watching how everyone sees you.
Take care of yourself first.

Be okay today —
so that tomorrow's you
will have the strength to catch tomorrow.
en.editorNote: For a character's turning point out of a low patch or self-doubt; also lands as a gentle line to comfort a friend, perfect for healing dramas
variations: Take care of today's you. Tomorrow can wait until tomorrow.
You don't have to satisfy everyone. You just have to make it through.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 時間與選擇主題人生金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你現在過的日子，
是你以前每一個選擇疊出來的。

所以別怪命運，
命運只是把你選過的路，
一條一條走給你看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色回望人生、承擔自己決定的橋段，旁白或關鍵獨白時特別有重量
variations: 此刻的你，是過去無數次「就這樣吧」換來的。
不是命運找上你，是你一路走成了現在的自己。

en.content:
The life you're living now
is every choice you ever made, stacked up.

So don't blame fate.
Fate just walks you, step by step,
down the roads you already picked.
en.editorNote: For a character looking back and owning their decisions; carries real weight as narration or a pivotal monologue
variations: Who you are today is every quiet 'good enough' you ever settled for.
Fate didn't find you. You walked yourself into this.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 談戀愛與對的人主題金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
談戀愛其實很麻煩，
要花時間，要顧對方心情，
還要猜他到底在想什麼。

但如果那個人是對的，
這些麻煩就不叫麻煩了，
叫做——我願意。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合猶豫要不要投入一段感情的角色，最後被打動的那一刻，甜而不膩
variations: 遇到對的人，連猜心都變成一件甜的事。
麻煩沒有變少，是我變得願意了。

en.content:
Love is honestly a hassle.
It takes time, it takes minding someone's feelings,
it takes guessing what they're thinking.

But when the person is right,
none of that feels like a hassle anymore.
It just feels like — I want to.
en.editorNote: For a character hesitating to commit, right at the moment they're won over; sweet without tipping into saccharine
variations: With the right person, even guessing their mind turns sweet.
The trouble didn't shrink. I just became willing.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 低谷與希望主題治癒金句，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
沒事的，
我們只是現在不順，
又不是一輩子都這樣。

把頭抬起來，
好事正在來的路上，
只是還沒到而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色卡在人生低谷、需要被拉一把的橋段，也適合當作打氣台詞轉給撐得很累的人
variations: 現在的難，是有期限的，撐過去就換場景了。
不順只是這一段，不是整部戲。

en.content:
It's okay.
We're just having a rough stretch right now —
it's not the rest of our lives.

Lift your head.
Good things are already on their way.
They just haven't arrived yet.
en.editorNote: For a character stuck at the bottom who needs a hand up; also works as a pep-talk line to forward to someone worn out from holding on
variations: This hard part has an expiry date. Get through it and the scene changes.
The rough patch is one stretch — not the whole story.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 「你的幸福為什麼要問別人」自主快樂主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你把新剪的頭髮拍照傳給三個人，
等到第三個人回「好看」，
才敢走出理髮廳的門。

有人問你：「那你自己喜歡嗎？」
你愣了兩秒，說：「我還沒想過。」

下次先想這個，其他的等等再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色卡在別人的評價裡走不出來、被一句話點醒的橋段，也適合轉給總在等外界認可的朋友
variations: 把幸福的遙控器拿回自己手上，別再讓別人幫你轉台。
他們的認可是加分題，不是你及不及格的標準。

en.content:
You keep waiting for someone to say 'you're doing great,'
like you can't feel okay until they nod.

But happiness isn't theirs to hand out.
You're the one who gets to decide.

Next time, don't ask 'is this good enough?'
Just ask yourself 'am I happy?'
en.editorNote: For a character stuck inside other people's opinions, snapped out of it by one line; also great to forward to a friend always waiting on outside approval
variations: Take the remote back. Stop letting other people change your channel.
Their approval is a bonus round, not your passing grade.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 「既然倒下了那就躺著吧」低谷休息主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
都已經跌倒了，
就先別急著爬起來。

躺一下沒關係，
地板也是可以喘氣的地方。

等你歇夠了再站，
沒有人在計時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色累到撐不住、身邊有人輕輕接住他的橋段，把「休息」講得理直氣壯而不狼狽
variations: 站不起來不是輸，是身體在提醒你該停了。
先躺著，世界不會因為你休息五分鐘就塌。

en.content:
You already fell down —
so don't rush to get back up.

It's fine to lie there a while.
The floor can be a place to catch your breath too.

Stand when you've rested enough.
Nobody's running a stopwatch.
en.editorNote: For a character worn past their limit, gently caught by someone; makes 'resting' sound like a right, not a defeat
variations: Not standing isn't losing. It's your body saying it's time to stop.
Stay down a bit. The world won't collapse over a five-minute break.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 拋開理智的告白主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我本來想撐到最後都保持清醒的，
結果還是輸了。

最近老是看到一些不該看到的畫面——
轉角有你，人群裡也有你，
連閉上眼睛都是你。

所以這算是⋯⋯我跟你告白了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合原本理性克制的角色終於守不住那道防線的橋段，語氣半是投降半是甜，告白台詞轉給暗戀對象也很殺
variations: 我努力裝作沒事，可惜眼睛太誠實。
說好不動心的是我，先舉白旗的也是我。

en.content:
I meant to keep my head clear right to the end.
Turns out I lost anyway.

Lately I keep seeing things I shouldn't —
you at every corner, you in every crowd,
you even when I close my eyes.

So I guess this is... me confessing to you.
en.editorNote: For a guarded, level-headed character who finally can't hold the line; half surrender, half sweet — also a killer confession to send to a crush
variations: I tried to act fine. My eyes were just too honest about it.
I'm the one who swore not to fall. I'm also the one waving the white flag.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 淚之女王「愛是一起承受痛苦」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
愛不是只有牽手、只有甜言蜜語。

真正的愛是——
日子難的時候，
他沒有轉身走，
選擇留下來陪你一起爛、一起撐。

順的時候誰都在，
難的時候還在，那才叫愛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一對經歷過低谷的伴侶回望彼此的橋段，也適合放在婚禮或紀念日的旁白，重量剛好不煽情
variations: 會一起淋雨的，比只在晴天出現的珍貴。
愛不是永遠開心，是壞天氣裡他還沒放開你的手。

en.content:
Love isn't just holding hands and sweet nothings.

Real love is —
when things get hard,
he doesn't turn and walk away.
He chooses to stay, to fall apart with you, to hold on.

Anyone's around when it's easy.
Still there when it's hard — that's love.
en.editorNote: For a couple who've been through the bottom looking back at each other; also lands as wedding or anniversary narration — weighty without tipping into melodrama
variations: The one who'll stand in the rain with you beats the one who only shows up on sunny days.
Love isn't always being happy. It's him not letting go in the bad weather.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 「大家都是裝出來的」成長真相主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你以為長大就會懂事，
其實沒有。

人到最後也不會突然變成熟，
只是學會把慌張藏好，
笑著說「我沒事」。

大家都在裝，
差別只是誰裝得比較像。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色卸下堅強面具、坦承自己也在硬撐的橋段，一句話戳破「大人都很穩」的假象，特別有共鳴
variations: 所謂成熟，只是把崩潰改成靜音而已。
沒有人真的準備好，只是輪到你上場了。

en.content:
You think growing up means you'll figure it out.
You don't.

Nobody suddenly becomes mature at the end.
You just learn to hide the panic
and smile and say 'I'm fine.'

Everyone's faking it.
The only difference is who fakes it better.
en.editorNote: For a character dropping the tough-it-out mask and admitting they're winging it too; punctures the 'adults have it together' myth in one line — deeply relatable
variations: Being mature just means switching your breakdown to silent mode.
Nobody's actually ready. It was just your turn to walk on.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 低谷醫生/治癒系韓劇「情緒生病像感冒」主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
情緒也會生病，就跟感冒一樣。

沒有人會罵你怎麼又感冒了，
那你為什麼要罵自己怎麼又難過了？

心累了就休息，
哭完了再站起來，
這不是脆弱，
是你還願意好好活著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色安慰陷入低潮的人、或整部戲的療癒主旨橋段；把「情緒低落」正常化，不說教又暖，配柔和音樂特別有力道
variations: 黑夜再長，早上的太陽還是會照進來。
你不是壞掉了，只是需要一點時間充電。

en.content:
Feelings get sick too — just like catching a cold.

Nobody yells at you for coming down with a cold,
so why do you yell at yourself for feeling low again?

Rest when your heart is tired.
Stand back up once you've finished crying.
That's not weakness —
it means you still want to live well.
en.editorNote: For a character comforting someone in a slump, or a show's whole healing message; normalizes feeling down without preaching — warm, not corny, lands hard over soft music
variations: However long the night, the morning sun still finds its way in.
You're not broken. You just need a little time to recharge.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 欠妳的那場婚禮 婚姻裡的孤單主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
婚姻裡最傷人的，從來不是吵架。

是你明明睡在同一張床上，
卻覺得中間隔了一整片海。

他不是不愛了，
只是忘了問你今天過得好不好。

感情不是敗給大事，
是敗給那些沒說出口的小事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合中年夫妻漸行漸遠、或一方終於開口談心的橋段；點出婚姻的孤單是日常的忽略累積出來的，扎心但不狗血
variations: 最遠的距離，是同住一個屋簷下卻沒話說。
壓垮感情的從來不是大浪，是每天沒接住的那句話。

en.content:
The most painful thing in a marriage was never the fighting.

It's lying in the same bed
and feeling an entire ocean between you.

He didn't stop loving you.
He just forgot to ask how your day was.

Love doesn't lose to the big things.
It loses to the small ones nobody says out loud.
en.editorNote: For a middle-aged couple drifting apart, or one of them finally opening up; names how marital loneliness builds from everyday neglect — cuts deep without melodrama
variations: The farthest distance is living under one roof with nothing left to say.
Love isn't sunk by the big waves — it's the daily words nobody catches.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 你的幸福為什麼要問別人 自我價值主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你的幸福，為什麼要問別人？

別人覺得你該結婚、該買房、該有份穩定的工作，
那是他們的劇本，不是你的人生。

過得好不好，
只有睡前那個安不安心的你自己知道。

別再拿別人的尺，
量自己的路。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色被親戚逼問、或主角決定走自己那條路的橋段；一句話把「別人的期待」還給別人，看了很解氣
variations: 你的人生不用過給別人打分數。
合不合腳只有你知道，別人只是在旁邊喊尺碼。

en.content:
Why are you asking other people whether you're happy?

They think you should marry, buy a house, land a stable job —
that's their script, not your life.

Whether you're doing okay
is something only the you at bedtime, calm or not, really knows.

Stop measuring your own road
with somebody else's ruler.
en.editorNote: For a character cornered by nosy relatives, or the lead choosing their own path; hands other people's expectations right back to them — very satisfying
variations: Your life doesn't need anyone else's grade.
Only you know if the shoe fits — everyone else is just shouting sizes from the sidelines.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 請回答吧系列 長大與回不去的家主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
小時候一直想快點長大，
長大後才發現，
最想回去的，是那個回不去的家。

媽媽的嘮叨、爸爸的沉默、
那頓不怎麼樣卻怎麼也吃不膩的晚餐——

原來我們拚命往前跑，
是為了有一天，能笑著想起這些。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合全家團圓、或角色離鄉多年回望的橋段；把「長大的代價」講得溫柔，年節、畢業季播特別催淚
variations: 長大就是，你終於懂了那些當年嫌煩的話。
家不會等你，所以有空就多回去看看。

en.content:
As kids we couldn't wait to grow up.
Grown up, we finally realize
the place we most want to return to is the home we can't go back to.

Mom's nagging, Dad's silence,
that unremarkable dinner we somehow never got tired of —

turns out we ran so hard forward
just so one day we could smile remembering all of this.
en.editorNote: For a family reunion, or a character who left home long ago looking back; frames the cost of growing up tenderly — extra tearful around holidays and graduation season
variations: Growing up is finally understanding the words that used to annoy you.
Home won't wait for you — so go back and visit while you still can.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 2026治癒系韓劇金句 情緒低潮主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你不必每天都很好。

有些日子你只是把早餐吃完、把窗簾拉開，
這樣就已經很勇敢了。

難過的時候不用急著找答案，
答案有時候不是想出來的，
是撐過去之後，某天突然懂的。

先照顧好今天的自己，
明天的事，明天再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色陷入低潮、朋友遞上一杯熱茶的橋段；轉給最近很累的人，不催他振作，只陪他喘口氣
variations: 你已經很努力了，現在可以先休息一下。
撐不住的時候，把標準降低一點也沒關係。

en.content:
You don't have to be okay every single day.

Some days, just finishing breakfast and opening the curtains
is already brave enough.

When you're hurting, don't rush to find the answer.
Some answers aren't figured out —
you just hold on, and one day they quietly make sense.

Take care of today's you first.
Tomorrow can wait until tomorrow.
en.editorNote: For a character in a slump, or the friend who hands them a warm cup of tea; send to someone who's worn out — it doesn't push them to bounce back, it just sits with them
variations: You've already tried so hard. It's okay to rest now.
When you can't hold it together, lowering the bar a little is allowed.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 相信是一種選擇 韓劇人性主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
有人問我，為什麼還敢相信人？

我說，不是因為對方值得，
是因為如果連信都不敢，
我就只剩下自己一個人了。

相信不是別人給你的證明，
是你自己做的選擇。

就算偶爾被辜負，
我也不想活成一個誰都不敢靠近的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色在被背叛後仍選擇善良的橋段；把「相信」寫成一種勇氣而非天真，看的人會被戳中
variations: 相信人會受傷，但不相信人，會更孤單。
我選擇相信，不是因為傻，是因為我不想變冷。

en.content:
Someone asked me how I still dare to trust people.

I said it's not because they've earned it —
it's because if I don't dare to believe at all,
I'm left with no one but myself.

Trust isn't proof someone hands you.
It's a choice you make on your own.

Even if I get let down now and then,
I don't want to become someone no one can get close to.
en.editorNote: For a character who chooses kindness even after being betrayed; frames trust as courage rather than naivety — it lands harder that way
variations: Trusting people can hurt — but trusting no one hurts lonelier.
I choose to believe, not because I'm foolish, but because I refuse to go cold.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 分離時不會說謊 離別主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
人到了要說再見的那一刻，
就再也裝不下去了。

平常那些「我很好」「沒事」，
到了分開前全部塌掉，
只剩一句說不出口的「別走」。

原來我們一直在騙自己，
以為還有很多明天，
直到最後一天，才學會誠實。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合機場、病房或最後一面的離別戲；把「來不及說的話」寫得很輕，卻壓得人喘不過氣
variations: 最捨不得的話，往往是最晚才敢說的。
如果早知道是最後一次，我一定會抱久一點。

en.content:
The moment you have to say goodbye,
you can't keep pretending anymore.

All those everyday "I'm fine"s and "it's nothing"s
collapse right before you part,
leaving only one thing you can't get out: "don't go."

Turns out we'd been lying to ourselves the whole time,
thinking there'd be plenty of tomorrows —
until the last day taught us how to be honest.
en.editorNote: For an airport, hospital-room, or final-farewell scene; writes 'the words we ran out of time to say' softly, but it sits heavy on your chest
variations: The words you can't bear to say are usually the ones you say too late.
If I'd known it was the last time, I'd have held on a little longer.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 翻譯愛情 告白主題 Can This Love Be Translated 靈感，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我這個人，什麼都翻譯得出來，
唯獨翻譯不了我看你的那個眼神。

那不是「喜歡」兩個字裝得下的，
也不是任何一種語言講得清的。

我努力保持冷靜到最後一刻，
可是我還是瘋了——
我開始滿眼都是你。

這，就是我的告白。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合克制型角色終於破功的告白場面；把「理智輸給心動」寫得很浪漫，情人節、告白橋段好用
variations: 全世界的語言我都懂，只有你這一題我永遠解不開。
我本來想撐住的，結果第一個投降的是我自己。

en.content:
I can translate just about anything —
except the way I look at you.

That look is too big for the word "like,"
and no language I know can spell it out.

I held onto my composure until the very last second,
and still I lost my mind —
suddenly you're all I see.

So. This is me confessing.
en.editorNote: For the guarded character who finally cracks and confesses; frames 'reason losing to the heart' as pure romance — great for Valentine's or a confession scene
variations: I understand every language in the world — except the riddle that is you.
I meant to hold the line. Turns out I was the first to surrender.

items.sourceNote: internal only — 金錢成就之外還有很多值得追求 幸福主題，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
這世界上，除了錢和成就，
還有太多值得你留下來的東西。

一頓有人等你回家的晚餐、
一場說走就走的海邊、
一個不用解釋就懂你的人。

別把人生活成一張成績單，
上面填滿分數，卻沒有一格
是留給快樂的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色被功利世界磨到麻木、重新找回生活重心的橋段；提醒觀眾「贏了世界卻弄丟自己」不划算
variations: 成就會過期，但被愛的感覺不會。
拚命賺明天的錢，卻忘了過今天的日子，這不划算。

en.content:
In this world, beyond money and achievement,
there's so much more worth staying for.

A dinner where someone's waiting for you to come home,
a spur-of-the-moment trip to the sea,
a person who gets you without needing an explanation.

Don't live your life like a report card —
every box filled with a score,
and not one square left for joy.
en.editorNote: For a character worn numb by a cutthroat world, finding their center again; reminds viewers that 'winning the world but losing yourself' is a bad trade
variations: Achievements expire. The feeling of being loved doesn't.
Grinding for tomorrow's money while forgetting to live today — that's a losing deal.

items.sourceNote: 不夠善良的我們 討論度話題，人性與慾望主題，原創改寫非引用原句

zh-tw.content:
人心最奇怪的地方是——

擁有的時候不覺得珍貴，
失去以後才開始想念；
得不到的永遠閃閃發光，
真正到手的反而變得普通。

我們一輩子都在追那個
「如果當初」，
卻沒好好看看眼前這個
「還好有你」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色在感情裡患得患失、把現有的人看得太輕的橋段；也能配「回不去了」的回憶殺畫面
variations: 越得不到的越迷人，越留不住的越難忘，這大概就是人最沒藥醫的病。
你以為在懷念那個人，其實你懷念的是當時什麼都還來得及的自己。

en.content:
The strangest thing about the human heart —

we don't feel the value of what we have,
only start to miss it once it's gone;
what we can't reach always glitters,
what we finally hold turns ordinary.

We spend our whole lives chasing
that 'what if I had,'
and never really look at the person
right here — the 'thank god you stayed.'
en.editorNote: For a character who takes a present love for granted, or paired with a bittersweet 'we can't go back' flashback
variations: The more out of reach, the more magnetic. The harder to keep, the harder to forget. It's the one sickness with no cure.
You think you miss that person — really you miss the version of you back when everything was still fixable.

items.sourceNote: 此時此刻 療癒愛情主題，快樂與痛苦累積概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
後來我才懂，
快樂不是一種天生的體質，
是熬過來的。

那些讓你哭到不行的夜晚，
那些以為撐不過去的關卡，
都會變成日後你笑得出來的底氣。

沒有白受的苦，
只有還沒兌現的溫柔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色從低谷慢慢走出來、回頭看才發現一切都值得的橋段；發限動配深夜心情剛剛好
variations: 現在的難，都是在幫以後的你存快樂。
撐過去你就會發現，那些痛不是要毀掉你，是要把你磨得更難被打倒。

en.content:
It took me a while to get it —
happiness isn't something you're born with,
it's something you survive your way into.

The nights you cried yourself empty,
the walls you swore you couldn't climb,
all turn into the reason you can smile later.

No pain is wasted.
Some of it is just tenderness that hasn't been cashed in yet.
en.editorNote: For a character slowly climbing out of a low point and realizing it was all worth it; perfect for a late-night story post
variations: Everything that's hard right now is just saving up joy for the you down the road.
Get through it and you'll see — the pain wasn't there to break you, it was there to make you harder to knock down.

items.sourceNote: 此時此刻 愛情死角意象，錯過的風景概念，原創重寫

zh-tw.content:
眼睛看東西有死角，
愛也一樣。

有些人明明就在你身邊，
你卻因為看得太習慣而看不見；
等你終於轉過頭，
他已經走到你視線之外了。

愛情最可惜的，
不是沒遇到，
是遇到了，卻剛好在盲區。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合錯過型愛情、暗戀多年終於錯身的橋段；也能當「原來你也曾經那麼靠近」的旁白
variations: 你以為的理所當然，其實是別人偷偷用力撐著的。
最遠的距離不是沒愛過，是他站在你的盲區，剛好被你忽略了一輩子。

en.content:
Your eyes have blind spots.
So does love.

Some people are standing right beside you,
and you stop seeing them
because you're too used to the view;
by the time you finally turn your head,
they've already walked out of frame.

The saddest thing about love
isn't never meeting —
it's meeting, and landing in the blind spot.
en.editorNote: For near-miss love, or a years-long crush that finally passes by; works as voiceover for 'turns out you were that close too'
variations: What you took for granted was really someone quietly holding it up.
The farthest distance isn't never having loved — it's them standing in your blind spot, overlooked for a lifetime.

items.sourceNote: 人生只租不賣 租屋題材台語劇 discussion，居住比喻人生，原創格式

zh-tw.content:
有人說，人生就像租房子——

地段不是你選的（出生），
押金要付一輩子（責任），
房東三不五時漲租（現實），
想搬也不是說搬就搬（現況）。

但租來的房子，
照樣可以擺上你喜歡的燈、
養一盆會開花的植物、
把日子過成自己的樣子。

人生只租不賣，
那就把它住得漂亮一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合小人物在現實裡認命卻不擺爛、把日子過得有滋味的橋段；租屋族看了會心一笑又有點鼻酸
variations: 反正都是租的，何必把自己活得像在替房東省水電。
房子是租的，但你在裡面笑過哭過的每一天，都是你自己的。

en.content:
Someone said life is like renting a place —

you don't pick the neighborhood (birth),
the deposit takes a lifetime to pay (responsibility),
the landlord hikes the rent whenever (reality),
and you can't just move out on a whim (your situation).

But even a rented place
can hold the lamp you love,
a plant that actually blooms,
and days shaped exactly like you.

Life is lease-only, never for sale —
so live in it beautifully.
en.editorNote: For an everyday character who accepts reality without giving up, making a small life feel rich; hits home for anyone who rents
variations: It's all rented anyway — why live like you're saving the landlord money on the utilities.
The place is rented, but every day you laughed and cried inside it is entirely your own.

items.sourceNote: 影后 台劇金句人生指引話題，當自己人生主角概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
你不用當別人故事裡的配角，
拚命等一句台詞、
爭一個鏡頭、
盼一次被看見。

你就是你自己人生的主角，
這齣戲從頭到尾，
鏡頭只跟著你。

就算沒人給你掌聲，
也要把每一場戲，
認真演到最後一秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色從討好別人、活在別人期待裡，轉為為自己而活的高光時刻；當座右銘或畢業季文案也很搭
variations: 別在別人的故事裡當背景，你有你自己要演的主線。
沒有觀眾也沒關係，這齣戲本來就是演給你自己看的。

en.content:
You don't have to play the side character
in someone else's story —
waiting for a single line,
fighting for one shot,
begging to be seen.

You're the lead in your own life.
From the first scene to the last,
the camera only follows you.

Even if no one claps,
play every scene
like it matters down to the final second.
en.editorNote: For a character shifting from people-pleasing to living for themselves; works as a motto or a graduation-season caption
variations: Stop being the background in someone else's story — you've got your own lead role to play.
No audience? Doesn't matter. This show was always meant for you to watch.

items.sourceNote: 敗犬女王女主角堅強語錄話題，學會保護自己概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
沒有人天生就想變堅強。

是被丟下過一次，
才學會自己撐傘；
是等過一個不會回的人，
才學會把門關好；
是哭到沒人接，
才學會把眼淚擦乾再出門。

所謂長大，
不是不再受傷，
是受傷之後，
還能自己站起來，
順便把地上的碎片掃乾淨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色經歷背叛或失戀後獨自振作的轉場戲；也很適合貼給剛走出一段關係、正在重新站穩的朋友
variations: 堅強不是天賦，是每一次沒人扶你，你還是自己爬起來練出來的。
我不是變冷漠了，我只是終於學會，先把自己接住。

en.content:
Nobody is born wanting to be tough.

You learn to hold your own umbrella
because someone once left you in the rain.
You learn to lock the door
because you waited for someone who never came back.
You learn to dry your own tears before heading out
because you once cried and no one picked up.

Growing up isn't never getting hurt.
It's getting hurt,
then standing back up on your own —
and sweeping the broken pieces off the floor while you're at it.
en.editorNote: For the scene where a character pulls themselves together alone after betrayal or heartbreak; also perfect to send a friend just finding their footing after a breakup
variations: Strength isn't a gift. It's what you build every time no one catches you and you get up anyway.
I didn't turn cold. I just finally learned to catch myself first.

items.sourceNote: 必娶女人幸福靠自己搶來語錄話題，主動爭取幸福概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
這世界上沒有從天上掉下來的幸福，
也沒有理所當然的被愛。

你想要的那個人、那份工作、那種生活，
不會因為你夠善良就自動送到你面前。

幸福從來不是等來的，
是你伸手去搶、
開口去要、
跌倒了再站起來拚回來的。

乖乖排隊的人，
往往最後才發現，
這裡根本沒有在發號碼牌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合女主角從被動等待轉為主動出擊的高光台詞；當座右銘或激勵文案都很有力道
variations: 別再等別人給你幸福了，那東西沒有宅配，只能自取。
善良不會自動換來好結果，你還得為自己開口爭一次。

en.content:
There's no happiness that just falls from the sky,
and no love that shows up because you deserve it.

The person you want, the job you want, the life you want —
none of it arrives just because you're a good person.

Happiness was never something you wait for.
It's something you reach out and grab,
something you speak up and ask for,
something you fall down and fight your way back to.

The ones who wait politely in line
usually find out too late
that no one was handing out numbers.
en.editorNote: For the lead's turning-point line, shifting from passive waiting to going after what she wants; a strong motto or motivational caption
variations: Stop waiting for someone to deliver your happiness — it doesn't ship, it's pickup only.
Being kind won't cash out on its own. You still have to speak up and fight for your turn.

items.sourceNote: 我可能不會愛你這輩子很長也很短語錄話題，人生長短對照概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
有人說，這輩子其實很長，
長到你跌倒了，
還有時間慢慢站起來，
把摔痛的地方拍一拍，繼續走。

可這輩子其實也很短，
短到你沒空再勉強自己去愛不對的人，
沒空再花力氣去討厭那個鏡子裡的自己。

長的部分，拿去原諒；
短的部分，留給值得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合角色在低潮後與自己和解的獨白；分手或轉職的過渡期貼給朋友，剛好接住那種說不上來的心情
variations: 人生長到夠你重來，也短到不夠你浪費在不愛你的人身上。
時間會慢慢治好你，前提是你別再親手撕開那道傷口。

en.content:
Someone said this life is actually long —
long enough that when you fall,
you still have time to slowly get up,
dust off the sore spot, and keep walking.

But this life is also short —
too short to keep forcing yourself to love the wrong person,
too short to keep spending energy hating the face in the mirror.

The long part, spend on forgiving.
The short part, save for what's worth it.
en.editorNote: For a character's monologue making peace with themselves after a rough patch; send it to a friend mid-breakup or mid-career-change — it catches that hard-to-name feeling
variations: Life is long enough to start over, and short enough that you shouldn't waste it on someone who doesn't love you.
Time will slowly heal you — as long as you stop reopening the wound yourself.

items.sourceNote: 台灣戲劇語錄陪伴情話，不會放你一個人哭概念，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我沒辦法保證天天把你逗笑，
畢竟我有時候也很累、很無趣，
連自己都想翻自己白眼。

但有一件事我很確定：
以後不管日子多難，
我都不會讓你一個人躲在角落哭。

你笑的時候我陪你笑，
你哭的時候，
我會把整個人借你靠，
哭完了，再一起把眼淚擦掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合男主角不擅甜言蜜語卻真心承諾的告白戲；情人節、週年紀念貼給另一半剛剛好，土得很誠懇
variations: 我不會說很多好聽的話，但你要哭的時候，我一定在。
逗你笑我不一定做得到，但陪你哭這件事，交給我。

en.content:
I can't promise to make you laugh every single day —
some days I'm tired and dull,
the kind of guy even I want to roll my eyes at.

But there's one thing I'm sure of:
no matter how hard life gets from here,
I won't let you cry alone in some corner.

When you laugh, I'll laugh with you.
When you cry,
I'll lend you my whole self to lean on,
and when it's over, we'll wipe the tears away together.
en.editorNote: For the confession scene where the male lead is bad with sweet words but means every one; cheesy in the most sincere way — great for a Valentine's or anniversary message to your partner
variations: I'm not good with pretty words, but when you need to cry, I'll be there.
I can't promise I'll make you laugh, but crying? Leave that one to me — I've got you.

items.sourceNote: 八點檔洗咧哈囉機關槍台詞話題，鄉土劇誇張嗆聲幽默，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
八點檔教會我們的人生技能：

吵架時要先深呼吸——
不是為了冷靜，
是為了一口氣念完三十個字不換氣。

被冤枉時要側身四十五度、
手指顫抖、眼神含淚，
然後一句「你剌洗咧哈囉」定生死。

真相永遠留到下一集，
巴掌永遠打在鏡頭切掉的瞬間，
而失散多年的親人，
總是在你最不需要的時候認回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給最愛陪長輩看八點檔的家人，或家族群組——大家都懂那種又浮誇又上癮的魔力，笑到不行
variations: 八點檔第一守則：任何事都可以用一巴掌加一句「你嘛卡差不多欸」解決。
現實吵架三秒就詞窮，八點檔演員可以連罵三集不重複，這就是專業。

en.content:
Life skills that prime-time soap operas taught us:

Before an argument, take a deep breath —
not to calm down,
but to fire off thirty words without pausing to inhale.

When falsely accused, turn forty-five degrees,
let your fingers tremble and your eyes well up,
then settle it all with one thunderous 'HOW DARE YOU.'

The truth is always saved for next episode,
the slap always lands the instant the camera cuts,
and the long-lost relative
always reappears exactly when you least need them.
en.editorNote: Send to the family member who watches soaps with the grandparents, or drop it in the family chat — everyone knows that over-the-top, weirdly addictive magic
variations: Soap opera rule number one: anything can be resolved with one slap and a 'you've gone too far.'
In real life you run out of words in three seconds; a soap actor can rant for three episodes straight without repeating. That's craft.

items.sourceNote: 《忘了我記得》長照失智題材金句「人都是一瞬間變老的」，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《忘了我記得》有一句，
我看完靜了很久：

「人，不是慢慢變老的，
是一瞬間。」

是那次他伸手扶樓梯，
是那次他問你同一句話兩遍，
是那次他把你的名字
喊成了別人的。

你一直以為老是慢慢來的，
有很多時間可以準備。

可是它不是。

它是某個很普通的下午，
你突然發現
那個曾經牽你過馬路的人，
現在過馬路
要牽你的手。

所以別再說「下次再回家」，
下次
不一定會等你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在心裡，或悄悄傳給好一陣子沒回家的自己——提醒你，有些陪伴沒有下一次
variations: 短版：人不是慢慢變老的，是在你沒注意的那一瞬間。
換句話說：你以為還有很多個下次，其實下次早就在倒數了。

en.content:
There's a line in a drama about a father losing his memory
that left me sitting in silence:

"People don't grow old slowly.
They grow old all at once."

It's the day he reaches for the railing.
The day he asks you the same question twice.
The day he calls your name
and it comes out as someone else's.

You always thought aging was gradual —
that there'd be plenty of time to get ready.

But there isn't.

It's some ordinary afternoon
when you suddenly notice
that the person who once held your hand
across the street
now needs you to hold theirs.

So stop saying 'I'll go home next time.'
Next time
might not wait for you.
en.editorNote: Keep this one close, or quietly send it to the version of yourself who hasn't been home in a while — some visits don't get a next time
variations: Short version: nobody grows old slowly — it happens in the moment you weren't looking.
Put another way: you think there are plenty of next times, but they've already started counting down.

items.sourceNote: 《忘了我記得》照顧者矛盾金句「我怕你走不了，也怕你太快走了」，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《忘了我記得》裡最痛的一句，
是照顧者才懂的矛盾：

「我怕你走不了，
也怕你太快走。」

沒照顧過生病的家人，
可能覺得這句很奇怪。

但陪過的人都懂——

你怕他撐得太辛苦，
每一天都在受苦，
拖著一副不聽話的身體。

可你又怕，
那個電話
哪天真的響起。

你一邊祈禱他不要痛，
一邊祈禱他不要走，
這兩個願望
偏偏不能同時成立。

這世上最累的
不是身體，
是你連希望
都不知道該許哪一個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 獻給正在照顧生病家人的你——這種說不出口的兩難，有人懂，你不是壞人
variations: 短版：我怕你太辛苦，又怕你真的走——這兩個願望，我一個都不敢許。
照顧者的日常：白天求你快點好起來，深夜求你千萬別走。

en.content:
The most painful line in that drama
is one only a caregiver truly understands:

"I'm afraid you won't be able to go —
and afraid you'll go too soon."

If you've never cared for a sick loved one,
this might sound like a contradiction.

But anyone who has
knows exactly what it means.

You're afraid they're suffering too much,
hurting a little more every day,
trapped in a body that no longer obeys.

And yet you're terrified
of the day
that phone call finally comes.

You pray for them to stop hurting.
You pray for them to stay.
And those two prayers
can never both come true.

The most exhausting thing in the world
isn't the body —
it's not even knowing
which wish you're allowed to make.
en.editorNote: For anyone caring for a sick family member — that unspeakable double bind is real, and it doesn't make you a bad person
variations: Short version: I'm scared of how much you're hurting, and scared of losing you — and I can't safely wish for either.
A caregiver's day: by daylight you beg them to get better, by midnight you beg them not to leave.

items.sourceNote: 《不夠善良的我們》金句「解決孤單這一題，兩個人就生一堆麻煩」，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《不夠善良的我們》有一句，
單身的人看了會偷偷點頭：

「一個人，
只要解決『孤單』這一題就好。
兩個人，
就會生出一大堆的麻煩。」

談戀愛之前你以為，
有人陪就不孤單了。

真的在一起才發現——

孤單只是一題，
感情是整張考卷。

他為什麼已讀不回、
這句話是不是有別的意思、
過年要去誰家、
錢要怎麼算……

單身的孤單，
是安靜的。

兩個人的孤單，
是明明有人在旁邊，
卻更說不出口的那種。

所以別急，
先把一個人的日子過好，
那不是失敗，
那是及格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直被催婚、覺得自己很失敗的朋友——一個人過得好，本來就是一種能力
variations: 短版：一個人只要解決孤單，兩個人要解決的是一整張考卷。
單身的孤單是安靜的；兩個人的孤單，是身邊有人卻更孤單。

en.content:
There's a line in a drama about two women and one shared past
that single people quietly nod along to:

"On your own,
you only have one problem to solve: loneliness.
With two people,
you breed a whole pile of new ones."

Before dating, you assume
having someone means never being lonely.

Then you're actually together, and you learn —

loneliness was just one question.
A relationship is the entire exam.

Why hasn't he replied?
Did that sentence mean something else?
Whose family for the holidays?
How do we split the money?

The loneliness of being single
is quiet.

The loneliness of being a pair
is worse — someone's right there,
and you still can't say it out loud.

So don't rush.
Learn to live well on your own first.
That's not failure.
That's a passing grade.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend who keeps getting nagged about being single and feels like a failure — thriving solo is its own kind of skill
variations: Short version: alone, you solve one problem; together, you're handed the whole exam.
Single loneliness is quiet; couple loneliness is having someone beside you and feeling it more.

items.sourceNote: 台灣八點檔名台詞盤點「甘阿捏」「嘉明的味道」，原創幽默改寫

zh-tw.content:
八點檔教會台灣人的幾件事：

一、任何食物只要說出「這是嘉明的味道」，
馬上升級成家傳祕方，
吃一口就會流淚。

二、遇到不合理的事，
先誇張地睜大眼睛，
再說一句「甘阿捏？」
就能拖過整段廣告。

三、真相永遠留到下一集，
巴掌永遠打在鏡頭切走的瞬間，
失散的親人
永遠在你最不需要的時候回來。

四、只要配上那段「登登登」的音樂，
連你倒杯水
都像藏著三十年的家族恩怨。

看似很浮誇，
其實很療癒——
因為現實裡吵不贏的架，
八點檔幫你演到贏。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給最愛陪長輩看八點檔的家人，或家族群組——那種又浮誇又上癮的魔力，大家都懂
variations: 八點檔守則：任何危機都能用一句「甘阿捏」加一個瞪眼撐過去。
現實裡三秒就詞窮，八點檔演員能連飆三集不重複——這就叫專業。

en.content:
A few things Taiwanese prime-time soap operas taught us:

One. Any dish becomes a sacred family secret
the moment someone says
'this tastes just like Grandma's.'
One bite and the tears start.

Two. When something outrageous happens,
first widen your eyes dramatically,
then gasp 'HOW can this be?'
and you've killed the entire commercial break.

Three. The truth is always saved for next episode.
The slap always lands the instant the camera cuts away.
The long-lost relative
always returns exactly when you least need them.

Four. Cue that 'dun-dun-DUN' sting
and even you pouring a glass of water
looks like it hides a thirty-year family feud.

It seems over the top,
but it's oddly healing —
because the arguments you can't win in real life,
the soap wins for you.
en.editorNote: Send to the family member who watches soaps with the grandparents, or drop it in the family chat — everyone knows that campy, addictive magic
variations: Soap opera rule: any crisis can be survived with one gasp and a slow, dramatic stare.
In real life you run out of words in three seconds; a soap actor rants for three episodes straight without repeating. That's craft.

items.sourceNote: 《忘了我記得》金句「時間再也不夠用了」「我們都太努力了」，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
《忘了我記得》有兩句，
剛好戳中三十歲以後的我們：

「不知道從什麼時候開始，
覺得時間好像
再也不夠用了。」

還有——

「問題就在於，
我們都太努力了。」

年輕的時候覺得時間多到浪費，
睡到中午、追一整晚的劇、
以為以後有的是機會。

現在呢？

連好好吃頓飯都要排進行事曆，
連放空都覺得罪惡，
連生病
都想著「這樣會不會耽誤進度」。

我們把「努力」當成美德，
卻忘了——
有時候人生卡住，
不是因為你不夠拼，
是因為你根本沒讓自己
喘一口氣。

今晚，
什麼都別追、什麼都別趕，
就允許自己
浪費一點時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是把行程排到滿、連休息都要有理由的自己或朋友——你已經很努力了，可以停一下
variations: 短版：你不是不夠努力，你是太努力，忘了讓自己喘口氣。
年輕時嫌時間太多，現在連發呆都要偷偷排進行事曆。

en.content:
Two lines from that drama
land squarely on anyone past thirty:

"At some point I don't remember,
it started to feel like
there was never enough time."

And —

"The problem is,
we've all been trying too hard."

When you're young, time feels endless.
You sleep till noon, binge a whole season,
sure there'll be chances later.

And now?

Even eating a proper meal goes on the calendar.
Even doing nothing feels like a crime.
Even getting sick, you think,
'is this going to set me behind?'

We treat 'trying hard' as a virtue,
but we forget —
sometimes life stalls
not because you didn't push enough,
but because you never once let yourself
catch your breath.

Tonight,
chase nothing, rush nothing.
Just give yourself permission
to waste a little time.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend — or the self — who packs the calendar full and needs a reason just to rest; you've tried hard enough, you're allowed to pause
variations: Short version: it's not that you didn't try hard enough — you tried so hard you forgot to breathe.
Young, you thought time was endless; now you sneak 'staring into space' onto the calendar.

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句「情緒生病和感冒一樣正常」延伸，原創改寫成心情感冒觀察

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡有一句話，我抄在便利貼上：

「心情感冒，
跟身體感冒一樣，
不是你的錯。」

身體發燒，你會請假、會多喝水，
沒有人會說「你怎麼那麼弱」。

可是換成心情，
你卻逼自己「振作一點」、
「別想那麼多」、
「別人比你更慘」。

感冒需要休息，
心情也需要。

它不是壞掉，
只是需要一點時間，
跟一杯熱水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那個最近說「我沒事」但你知道他有事的朋友——讓他知道低潮不需要理由，也不需要道歉
variations: 短版：身體感冒你會休息，心情感冒你卻叫自己撐著，這不公平。
下次心裡難受，試著對自己說：「我只是感冒了，會好的。」

en.content:
There's a line from a Korean drama I stuck on a note:

"A sick heart
is just like a sick body —
it's not your fault."

When your body runs a fever, you rest, you drink water,
and nobody calls you weak.

But when it's your mood,
you force yourself to "snap out of it,"
"stop overthinking,"
"remember others have it worse."

A cold needs rest.
So does a heavy heart.

It isn't broken.
It just needs a little time,
and a cup of something warm.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps saying 'I'm fine' when you know they're not — a low patch needs no reason and no apology
variations: Short version: a body cold gets rest, a heart cold gets 'push through it.' That's not fair.
Next time it hurts, try telling yourself: 'I've just caught a cold. It'll pass.'

items.sourceNote: Netflix《欠妳的那場婚禮》金句「愛你不是因為你多有才華，是因為她愛你這個人」延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
一部講婚禮的韓劇，
有句台詞把我看愣住了：

「有人愛你，
不是因為你多會賺錢、
多有頭銜、多多人認識你。

是因為她愛的，
就是你這個人。」

我們花好多年
把自己堆成一張漂亮的履歷——
學歷、職稱、存款、人脈，
以為條件夠好就會被愛。

可是真正留下來的人，
從來不是看上你那張表。

他看的是
你把履歷全部拿掉之後，
剩下的那個你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「要更成功才配被愛」的人——被愛的從來不是你的成就，是你本人
variations: 短版：他愛的不是你的頭銜，是頭銜底下那個你。
把履歷拿掉還願意留下的人，才是真的。

en.content:
A Korean drama about a wedding
had one line that stopped me cold:

"Someone loves you
not because of how much you earn,
your title, or how many people know your name.

They love
you —
the actual person."

We spend years
building ourselves into a good-looking résumé:
degrees, job titles, savings, connections,
sure that being impressive enough earns love.

But the ones who actually stay
never fell for the spec sheet.

They fell for
whoever's left
once you strip the résumé away.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who thinks they have to be more successful to deserve love — you're not loved for your achievements, you're loved for you
variations: Short version: they don't love your title. They love who you are underneath it.
The one who stays after you drop the résumé is the real one.

items.sourceNote: 《魷魚遊戲》名言「相信是一種選擇」延伸，原創改寫成信任觀察

zh-tw.content:
有句韓劇台詞我想了很久：

「相信一個人，
不是因為他值得，
是因為不相信，
自己就會孤單。」

長大後才懂，
這世界上沒有百分之百值得信任的人。

每一次選擇相信，
都是明知有風險，
還是把手伸出去。

不是傻，
是你不想活成
一個誰都不敢靠近的人。

相信會受傷，
但完全不相信，
是另一種更慢的受傷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被辜負過、開始不敢再相信任何人的朋友——防備能保護你，但也會把你關起來
variations: 短版：相信會受傷，不相信是另一種更慢的傷。
願意再一次伸手的人，不是傻，是勇敢。

en.content:
One Korean drama line stayed with me a long time:

"You trust someone
not because they've earned it,
but because without trust,
you end up all alone."

Growing up, you learn
there's no one on earth who's 100% safe to trust.

Every time you choose to believe someone,
you know the risk
and you reach out anyway.

Not naïve —
just unwilling to become
someone no one can get close to.

Trusting can hurt.
But trusting no one
is a slower kind of hurt.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend who got let down and stopped trusting anyone — your guard protects you, but it also locks you in
variations: Short version: trust can wound you; distrust is just a slower wound.
Reaching out one more time isn't naïve. It's brave.

items.sourceNote: 2026台劇《急診室的奇蹟》醫療寫實主題延伸，原創改寫成珍惜當下觀察

zh-tw.content:
一部急診室的台劇，
有段話讓我看完久久沒動：

「在這裡待久了才發現，
最珍貴的從來不是大事，

是有人早上還好好的，
說了聲『晚點見』，
就再也沒回來。」

我們總把感情話留到以後說，
把想見的人排到有空再約，
以為時間會一直在。

可是急診室教會人的第一件事就是——

沒有什麼是理所當然的，
包括明天，
包括你以為隨時都在的那個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看完想打電話給誰，就現在打——別把「晚點再說」留成遺憾
variations: 短版：想見的人現在就約，別把時間當成理所當然。
今天回家，記得跟身邊的人好好說一句話。

en.content:
A Taiwanese drama set in an ER
had a moment that kept me still long after:

"After enough time here, you realize
the most precious thing was never the big stuff.

It's that someone was fine this morning,
said 'see you later,'
and never came back."

We save the tender words for someday,
push the people we miss to 'when I'm free,'
assuming time will always be there.

But the first thing an ER teaches you is —

nothing is guaranteed,
not tomorrow,
not even the person you assumed would always be around.
en.editorNote: Whoever you thought of calling — call them now; don't let 'later' turn into a regret
variations: Short version: see the people you miss now. Don't treat time as a given.
When you get home tonight, say one real thing to the person beside you.

items.sourceNote: 2026療癒韓劇《努力克服自卑的我們》自卑與自我價值主題延伸，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
一部講自卑的韓劇，
有句話我抄了下來：

「你不是不夠好，
你只是一直拿自己
跟別人的高光時刻比。」

你看到的是他的成功，
沒看到他熬過的夜；
你看到的是他的從容，
沒看到他崩潰過幾次。

每個人的鏡頭都經過剪輯，
只有你，
把自己沒剪過的NG畫面
拿去跟人家的精華片段比。

難怪你總覺得自己輸。

可是輸的不是你，
是那場你根本不用參加的比賽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「別人都過得比我好」的朋友——你在跟別人的剪輯版比原始檔，怎麼比都不公平
variations: 短版：你拿自己的NG畫面，比別人的精華片段。
退出那場比賽吧，反正沒人規定你一定要參加。

en.content:
A Korean drama about self-doubt
had a line I wrote down:

"You're not not-good-enough.
You just keep comparing yourself
to everyone else's highlight reel."

You see their success,
not the nights they stayed up;
you see their ease,
not the times they fell apart.

Everyone's footage is edited.
Only you
take your own unedited bloopers
and hold them up against their greatest hits.

No wonder you always feel like you're losing.

But you're not losing.
You just entered a race
you never had to run.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's sure 'everyone's doing better than me' — you're comparing your raw footage to their edit; it was never a fair fight
variations: Short version: you're weighing your bloopers against everyone else's highlight reel.
Quit the race. Nobody said you had to run it.

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇《低谷醫生》主題延伸，關於醫生也會跌到谷底、允許自己不OK，原創改寫
